# salesforce

## SALESFORCE_ACCOUNT_CREATION_WITH_CONTENT_TYPE_OPTION
DEPRECATED: Creates a new Salesforce Account using a JSON POST request, requiring 'Name'; specific fields (e.g., custom, DunsNumber) may have org-level prerequisites.

## SALESFORCE_ADD_LEAD_TO_CAMPAIGN
Adds a lead to a campaign by creating a CampaignMember record, allowing you to track campaign engagement. Both `campaign_id` and `lead_id` must be valid Salesforce IDs of active, existing records — names or emails cannot be substituted, and deleted or inactive records will cause the call to fail. This is a persistent CRM write; confirm the correct lead and campaign before calling.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "AddLeadToCampaignRequest",

    "campaign_id",
    "lead_id"

        "Attended"

      "human_parameter_description": "How you want to mark the lead\u2019s participation in the campaign (for example, Sent or Responded). Pick the value that best matches their current stage; available options depend on the campaign."

      "title": "Lead Id",

        "00QXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"
      ],

      "human_parameter_description": "The Salesforce lead you want to add to the campaign. Paste the lead\u2019s ID (usually starts with '00Q') from the lead page URL or a prior search."

    "campaign_id": {

      "human_parameter_description": "The specific Salesforce campaign you want to add this lead to. Paste the campaign\u2019s ID (usually starts with '701') from the campaign page URL."

    "custom_fields": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Custom Fields",
      "examples": [
        {
          "VIP_Member__c": true,

        },
        {
          "External_Member_ID__c": "CM-7788"
        }
      ],
      "description": "Dictionary of custom field API names and their values for CampaignMember. Custom field names typically end with '__c'.",
```

## SALESFORCE_ADD_OPPORTUNITY_LINE_ITEM
Adds a product (line item) to an opportunity. The product must exist in a pricebook entry that's associated with the opportunity's pricebook.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "AddOpportunityLineItemRequest",
  "required": [
    "opportunity_id",
    "pricebook_entry_id",
    "quantity"

    "discount": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Discount",
      "examples": [
        10,
        25,
        5.5

      "human_parameter_name": "Discount",
      "human_parameter_description": "The percentage discount to apply to the unit price. Use only if you\u2019re pricing by unit, not when setting a total price."
    },

      "title": "Quantity",
      "examples": [
        1,
        5,
        10,
        100
      ],

      "type": "number",
      "title": "Total Price",

        500,
        1000,
        12500
      ],
      "description": "The total price for this line item. Cannot be used with UnitPrice or Discount.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Total Price",
```

## SALESFORCE_ASSOCIATE_CONTACT_TO_ACCOUNT
Associates a contact with an account by updating the contact's AccountId field. Overwrites any existing AccountId on the contact. For broader contact field updates alongside the account association, use SALESFORCE_UPDATE_CONTACT instead.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "AssociateContactToAccountRequest",
  "required": [
    "contact_id",
    "account_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "account_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Account Id",
      "examples": [
        "001XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"
      ],
      "description": "The Salesforce ID of the account to associate the contact with.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Account ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The Salesforce ID of the account you want this contact to belong to. Pick the target account\u2019s ID (it usually starts with 001) from the account record URL."
    },
    "contact_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Contact Id",
      "examples": [
        "003XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"
      ],
      "description": "The Salesforce ID of the contact to associate with an account.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Contact ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The unique Salesforce ID of the contact you want to link to an account. You can copy it from the contact\u2019s record URL (it usually starts with 003)."
    },
    "custom_fields": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Custom Fields",
      "examples": [
        {
          "Account_Association_Source__c": "Manual Update"
        },
        {
          "Priority_Contact__c": true
        }
      ],
      "description": "Dictionary of custom field API names and their values to update on the contact. Custom field names typically end with '__c'.",
      "additionalProperties": true,
      "human_parameter_name": "Custom Fields",

    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_CLONE_RECORD
Creates a copy of an existing Salesforce record by reading its data, removing system fields, and creating a new record. Optionally apply field updates to the clone.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CloneRecordRequest",
  "required": [
    "object_type",
    "record_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "record_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Record Id",
      "examples": [
        "001XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX",
        "003XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX",
        "00QXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the record to clone.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Record ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The unique ID of the record you want to clone. You can copy this from the record\u2019s URL or a previous search/list result."
    },
    "object_type": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Object Type",
      "examples": [
        "Account",
        "Contact",
        "Lead",
        "Opportunity",
        "Case"
      ],
      "description": "The Salesforce object type to clone (e.g., Account, Contact, Lead, Opportunity).",
      "human_parameter_name": "Object Type",
      "human_parameter_description": "The kind of Salesforce record you want to copy, like Account, Contact, Lead, or Opportunity. Choose the object the original record belongs to so we clone the right thing."
    },
    "field_updates": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Field Updates",
      "examples": [
        "{\"Name\": \"Clone of Original\"}",
        "{\"Status\": \"New\", \"OwnerId\": \"005XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX\"}"
      ],
      "description": "Optional field updates to apply to the cloned record as a JSON string. Use this to modify specific fields in the clone. Example: '{\"Name\": \"Clone of Original\", \"Status\": \"New\"}'",
      "human_parameter_name": "Field Updates",
      "human_parameter_description": "Any changes you want to make on the new copy, provided as a JSON string with field names and their new values. Use this to tweak details like Name, Status, or Owner on the cloned record."

  }
```

## SALESFORCE_CLOSE_OR_ABORT_JOB
Tool to close or abort a Salesforce Bulk API v2 ingest job. Use when you need to finalize job processing by closing (state: UploadComplete) or cancel a job by aborting (state: Aborted). This is required for every ingest job - closing queues data for processing, while aborting cancels the job and deletes uploaded data.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CloseOrAbortJobRequest",
  "required": [
    "job_id",
    "state"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "state": {
      "enum": [
        "UploadComplete",
        "Aborted"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "State",
      "examples": [
        "UploadComplete",
        "Aborted"
      ],
      "description": "The state to update the job to. 'UploadComplete' closes the job and queues uploaded data for processing. 'Aborted' cancels the job and deletes any uploaded data. This field is required."
    },
    "job_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Job Id",
      "examples": [
        "750dN00000BITXdQAP",
        "750XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the Bulk API v2 ingest job to close or abort."
    }
  }
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "CloseOrAbortJobResponse": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "CloseOrAbortJobResponse",
      "required": [
        "id",
        "operation",
        "object",
        "createdById",
        "createdDate",
        "systemModstamp",
        "state",
        "concurrencyMode",
        "contentType",
```

## SALESFORCE_COMPLETE_TASK
Marks a task as completed with optional completion notes. This is a convenience action that updates the task status to 'Completed'.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CompleteTaskRequest",
  "required": [
    "task_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "task_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Task Id",
      "examples": [
        "00TXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"
      ],
      "description": "The Salesforce ID of the task to mark as completed.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Task ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The unique Salesforce ID of the task you want to mark as completed. You can copy it from the task\u2019s URL or use an ID from a previous step."
    },
    "custom_fields": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Custom Fields",
      "examples": [
        {
          "Resolved__c": true,
          "Completion_Source__c": "Customer Call"
        },
        {
          "External_Task_ID__c": "TASK-4567"
        }
      ],
      "description": "Dictionary of custom field API names and their values. Custom field names typically end with '__c' (e.g., 'Completion_Source__c').",
      "additionalProperties": true,
      "human_parameter_name": "Custom Fields",
      "human_parameter_description": "Provide custom Salesforce fields to update alongside completion. Use the API field name (ending in '__c') as the key."
    },
    "completion_notes": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Completion Notes",
      "default": "",
      "examples": [
        "Call completed successfully. Customer agreed to proceed.",
        "Email sent. Received positive response.",
        "Meeting finished. Action items documented."
      ],
      "description": "Optional notes to add about the task completion. Will be appended to existing description.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Completion Notes",
      "human_parameter_description": "Any short note you want to include when closing the task. This will be added to the task\u2019s description for context and tracking."
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_COMPOSITE_GRAPH_ACTION
DEPRECATED: Use SALESFORCE_POST_COMPOSITE_GRAPH instead. Tool to execute multiple Salesforce REST API requests in a single call using composite graphs. Use when you need to perform a series of related operations that should either all succeed or all fail together. Composite graphs support up to 500 subrequests per graph (compared to 25 for regular composite requests) and allow referencing outputs from previous subrequests using @{referenceId.fieldName} syntax.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CompositeGraphRequest",
  "required": [
    "graphs"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "graphs": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "CompositeGraph",
        "required": [
          "graphId",
          "compositeRequest"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "graphId": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Graph Id",
            "examples": [
              "graph1",
              "accountCreationGraph",
              "bulkCreateGraph"
            ],
            "description": "Unique identifier for this graph. All subrequests in a graph are transactional - either all succeed or all are rolled back."
          },
          "compositeRequest": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "object",
              "title": "CompositeSubRequest",
              "required": [
                "method",
                "url",
                "referenceId"
              ],
              "properties": {
                "url": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "title": "Url",
                  "examples": [
                    "/services/data/v61.0/sobjects/Account",
                    "/services/data/v61.0/sobjects/Contact",
                    "/services/data/v61.0/query/?q=SELECT+Id+FROM+Account"
                  ],
                  "description": "Salesforce REST API endpoint path for the subrequest (e.g., '/services/data/v61.0/sobjects/Account'). Must be a valid Salesforce API path."
                },
                "body": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "title": "Body",
                  "examples": [
                    {
                      "Name": "Test Account"
                    },
                    {
                      "LastName": "Smith",
                      "AccountId": "@{newAccount.id}"
                    }
                  ],
                  "description": "Request payload for POST/PATCH/PUT operations. Can reference previous results using @{referenceId.fieldName} syntax (e.g., 'AccountId': '@{newAccount.id}').",
                  "additionalProperties": {
                    "anyOf": [
                      {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      {
                        "type": "integer"
                      },
                      {
                        "type": "number"
                      },
                      {
                        "type": "boolean"
                      },
                      {
                        "type": "array",
                        "items": {
                          "anyOf": [
                            {
                              "type": "string"
                            },
                            {
                              "type": "integer"
                            },
                            {
                              "type": "number"
                            },
                            {
                              "type": "boolean"
                            },
                            {
                              "type": "null"
                            }
                          ]
                        }
                      },
                      {
                        "type": "object",
                        "additionalProperties": {
                          "anyOf": [
                            {
                              "type": "string"
                            },
                            {
                              "type": "integer"
                            },
                            {
                              "type": "number"
                            },
                            {
                              "type": "boolean"
                            },
                            {
                              "type": "null"
                            }
                          ]
                        }
                      },
                      {
                        "type": "array",
                        "items": {
                          "type": "object",
                          "additionalProperties": {
                            "anyOf": [
                              {
                                "type": "string"
                              },
                              {
                                "type": "integer"
                              },
                              {
                                "type": "number"
                              },
                              {
                                "type": "boolean"
                              },
                              {
                                "type": "null"
                              }
                            ]
                          }
                        }
                      },
                      {
                        "type": "null"
                      }
                    ]
                  }
                },
                "method": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "title": "Method",
                  "examples": [
                    "POST",
                    "GET",
                    "PATCH",
                    "PUT",
                    "DELETE"
                  ],
                  "description": "HTTP method for the subrequest (GET, POST, PATCH, PUT, DELETE)."
                },
                "httpHeaders": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "title": "Http Headers",
                  "examples": [
                    {
                      "Content-Type": "application/json"
                    }
                  ],
                  "description": "Custom HTTP headers as key-value pairs for this specific subrequest.",
                  "additionalProperties": {
                    "type": "string"
                  }
                },
                "referenceId": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "title": "Reference Id",
                  "examples": [
                    "newAccount",
                    "NewContact",
                    "ref1"
                  ],
                  "description": "Unique identifier for this subrequest. Used to reference its output in subsequent requests using @{referenceId.fieldName} syntax."
                }
              },
              "description": "Represents a single subrequest within a composite graph."
            },
            "title": "Composite Request",
            "maxItems": 500,
            "minItems": 1,
            "description": "Array of subrequests to execute within this graph. Maximum 500 subrequests per graph."
          }
        },
        "description": "Represents a single graph containing multiple related subrequests."
      },
      "title": "Graphs",
      "examples": [
        [
          {
            "graphId": "graph1",
            "compositeRequest": [
              {
                "url": "/services/data/v61.0/sobjects/Account",
                "body": {
                  "Name": "Test Account"
                },
                "method": "POST",
                "referenceId": "newAccount"
              }
            ]
          }
        ]
      ],
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "Array of graph objects to execute. Each graph is transactional. Multiple graphs can be submitted in one request."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for the Composite Graph API."
}
```

## SALESFORCE_CREATE_ACCOUNT
Creates a new account in Salesforce with the specified information. Returns the created Account's ID at `data.response_data.id`.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateAccountRequest",
  "required": [
    "name"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "fax": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Fax",
      "default": "",
      "examples": [
        "(555) 123-4568",
        "+1-800-555-0124"
      ],
      "description": "Fax number.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Fax Number",
      "human_parameter_description": "The company\u2019s fax number, if applicable."
    },
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "Acme Corporation",
        "Global Enterprises Inc.",
        "Tech Innovations Ltd."
      ],
      "description": "Account name (required field in Salesforce).",
      "human_parameter_name": "Account Name",
      "human_parameter_description": "The official name of the company or organization you want to create in Salesforce. This is required so people can find and recognize the account."
    },
    "type": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Type",
      "default": "",
      "examples": [
        "Analyst",
        "Competitor",
        "Customer",
        "Integrator",
        "Investor",
        "Partner",
        "Press",
        "Prospect",
        "Reseller",
        "Other"
      ],
      "description": "Type of account.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Account Type",
      "human_parameter_description": "Select what kind of relationship this company has with you, like Customer, Partner, or Prospect. This helps categorize and report on the account."
    },
    "phone": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Phone",
      "default": "",
      "examples": [
        "(555) 123-4567",
        "+1-800-555-0123"
      ],
      "description": "Main phone number.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Phone Number",
      "human_parameter_description": "The main phone number for the company. Include country code if outside your region."
    },
    "website": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Website",
```

## SALESFORCE_CREATE_A_RECORD
Tool to create a Salesforce record using the UI API. Use when you need to create any type of Salesforce record with layout metadata and formatted field values.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateARecordRequest",
  "required": [
    "api_name",
    "fields"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "fields": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Fields",
      "examples": [
        {
          "Name": "Test Account",
          "Industry": "Technology"
        },
        {
          "Email": "jane@example.com",
          "LastName": "Doe",
          "FirstName": "Jane"
        },
        {
          "Name": "Account With Custom",
          "Custom_Field__c": "custom value"
        }
      ],
      "description": "Dictionary mapping field API names to their values. Keys are field API names (e.g., 'Name', 'FirstName', 'AccountId') and values are the data to set for those fields. Custom fields (ending in '__c') should be passed as direct key-value pairs, not nested under a 'CustomFields' key.",
      "additionalProperties": true
    },
    "api_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Api Name",
      "examples": [
        "Account",
        "Contact",
        "Opportunity",
        "Lead",
        "ContentNote"
      ],
      "description": "The API name of the Salesforce object to create (e.g., 'Account', 'Contact', 'Opportunity', 'ContentNote')."
    },
    "allow_save_on_duplicate": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Allow Save On Duplicate",
      "description": "Controls whether to allow saving when duplicates are detected. Note: Not currently supported in Lightning Web Components createRecord function."
    },
    "composio_execution_message": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Composio Execution Message",
      "description": "Internal message about input processing performed during execution."
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_CREATE_CAMPAIGN
Creates a new campaign in Salesforce. Only `name` is universally required, but org-level validation rules commonly enforce `type`, `status`, `start_date`, and `end_date` as well — omitting them may cause creation to fail.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateCampaignRequest",
  "required": [
    "name"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "Summer Sale 2024",
        "Q4 Email Campaign",
        "Product Launch"
      ],
      "description": "Campaign name (required field in Salesforce).",
      "human_parameter_name": "Campaign Name",
      "human_parameter_description": "The name of the campaign you want to create. Pick a clear, recognizable title so your team can find and report on it easily."
    },
    "type": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Type",
      "default": "",
      "examples": [
        "Conference",
        "Webinar",
        "Email",
        "Telemarketing",
        "Advertisement",
        "Partners",
        "Public Relations",
        "Other"
      ],
      "description": "Type of campaign.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Campaign Type",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose the kind of campaign (for example, Email, Webinar, or Conference) to categorize it for reporting."
    },
    "status": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Status",
      "default": "",
      "examples": [
        "Planned",
        "In Progress",
        "Completed",
        "Aborted"
      ],
      "description": "Current status of the campaign.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Campaign Status",
      "human_parameter_description": "Set the campaign\u2019s current status (such as Planned, In Progress, or Completed) so others know where it stands."
    },
    "end_date": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "End Date",
      "default": "",
      "examples": [
        "2024-01-31",
        "2024-06-30"
      ],
      "description": "Campaign end date in YYYY-MM-DD format.",
      "human_parameter_name": "End Date",
      "human_parameter_description": "The date the campaign ends (YYYY-MM-DD). Use this to define the campaign\u2019s timeframe."
    },
    "is_active": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Is Active",
      "default": false,
      "examples": [
        true,
        false
      ],
      "description": "Whether the campaign is currently active. Depending on org configuration, setting to `true` may require valid `start_date`/`end_date` ranges; violations raise a non-retriable `CANNOT_INSERT_UPDATE_ACTIVATE_ENTITY` error.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Is Active",
      "human_parameter_description": "Turn this on if the campaign is currently active. Leave it off for planned or completed campaigns."
    },
    "parent_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Parent Id",
      "default": "",
      "examples": [
        "701XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"
      ],
      "description": "ID of the parent campaign if this is a child campaign.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Parent Campaign ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "If this is a child campaign, provide the ID of its parent campaign to link them together. You can copy the parent campaign\u2019s ID from Salesforce."
    },
    "start_date": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Start Date",
      "default": "",
      "examples": [
        "2024-01-01",
        "2024-06-15"
      ],
      "description": "Campaign start date in YYYY-MM-DD format.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Start Date",
      "human_parameter_description": "The date the campaign begins (YYYY-MM-DD). This helps schedule and track the campaign timeline."
    },
    "actual_cost": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Actual Cost",
      "default": 0,
      "examples": [
        8500,
        4200.75,
        22000
      ],
      "description": "Actual cost spent on the campaign.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Actual Cost",
      "human_parameter_description": "How much has actually been spent on the campaign. Useful for comparing against the budget."
    },
    "description": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Description",
      "default": "",
      "examples": [
        "This campaign targets new customers in the Northeast region",
        "Q4 promotional campaign for existing customers"
      ],
      "description": "Detailed description of the campaign.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Campaign Description",
      "human_parameter_description": "Add notes about the campaign's goals, audience, offers, or messaging. This gives your team helpful context."
    },
    "number_sent": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Number Sent",
      "default": 0,
      "examples": [
        1000,
        5000,
        10000
      ],
      "description": "Number of individuals targeted by the campaign.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Number Sent",
      "human_parameter_description": "The number of people you plan to contact (or have contacted) in this campaign. Helps calculate metrics like response rate."
    },
    "budgeted_cost": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Budgeted Cost",
      "default": 0,
      "examples": [
        10000,
        5000.5,
        25000
      ],
      "description": "Budgeted cost for the campaign.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Budgeted Cost",
      "human_parameter_description": "How much you plan to spend on this campaign. Helps with budgeting and calculating ROI later."
    },
    "custom_fields": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Custom Fields",
      "examples": [
        {
          "Region__c": "North America",
          "Priority__c": "High"
        },
        {
          "Is_Priority__c": true,
          "Custom_Score__c": 85.5
        }
      ],
      "description": "Dictionary of custom field names and their values. Custom field names should end with '__c' (e.g., 'Priority__c', 'Region__c'). Values can be strings, numbers, booleans, or dates depending on the field type.",
      "additionalProperties": true,
      "human_parameter_name": "Custom Fields",
      "human_parameter_description": "Add any custom fields defined in your Salesforce org. Provide a dictionary where keys are the API names of your custom fields (ending in __c) and values are the data to set."
    },
    "expected_revenue": {
```

## SALESFORCE_CREATE_CUSTOM_FIELD
Tool to create a custom field on a Salesforce object using the Tooling API. Use when you need to add a new field (Text, Number, Checkbox, Date, Picklist, Lookup, etc.) to any standard or custom object without deploying metadata packages. The Tooling API provides direct field creation for rapid development and automation tasks.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateCustomFieldRequest",
  "required": [
    "object_api_name",
    "field_api_name",
    "field_type",
    "label"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "label": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Label",
      "examples": [
        "Customer Tier",
        "Priority Level",
        "Contract Value"
      ],
      "description": "The display label for the field shown in the Salesforce UI."
    },
    "scale": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Scale",
      "examples": [
        0,
        2,
        4
      ],
      "description": "Number of decimal places for Number, Currency, or Percent fields. Must be less than precision."
    },
    "length": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Length",
      "examples": [
        50,
        100,
        255
      ],
      "description": "Maximum character length for Text fields. Required for Text type, max 255 characters. Not applicable for LongTextArea."
    },
    "unique": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Unique",
      "default": false,
      "description": "If true, enforce that all values in this field are unique across all records (case-insensitive by default)."
    },
    "required": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Required",
      "default": false,
      "description": "If true, this field must be populated when creating or editing records."
    },
    "precision": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Precision",
      "examples": [
        10,
        16,
        18
      ],
      "description": "Total number of digits for Number, Currency, or Percent fields (including decimal places). Maximum is 18."
    },
    "field_type": {
      "enum": [
        "Text",
        "LongTextArea",
        "Number",
        "Checkbox",
        "Date",
        "DateTime",
        "Picklist",
        "MultiselectPicklist",
        "Lookup",
        "Email",
        "Phone",
        "Url",
        "Currency",
        "Percent"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Field Type",
      "examples": [
        "Text",
        "Number",
        "Checkbox",
        "Picklist",
        "Lookup"
      ],
      "description": "The type of custom field to create. Common types: Text (string up to 255 chars), LongTextArea (larger text), Number (integer or decimal), Checkbox (boolean), Date, DateTime, Picklist (single-select dropdown), MultiselectPicklist (multi-select), Lookup (relationship to another object), Email, Phone, Url, Currency, Percent."
    },
    "restricted": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Restricted",
      "description": "For Picklist/MultiselectPicklist fields, if true restricts values to only those defined in the picklist (no custom values allowed)."
    },
    "description": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Description",
      "examples": [
        "Indicates the customer's tier level for priority support."
      ],
      "description": "Optional description of the field's purpose and usage."
    },
    "external_id": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "External Id",
      "default": false,
      "description": "If true, marks this field as an external ID for integration purposes (allows upsert operations and improves query performance)."
    },
    "reference_to": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Reference To",
      "examples": [
        "Account",
        "Contact",
        "User",
        "CustomObject__c"
      ],
      "description": "For Lookup fields, the API name of the object this field references (e.g., 'Account', 'Contact', 'CustomObject__c')."
    },
    "default_value": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Default Value",
      "examples": [
        "false",
        "0",
        "2024-01-01"
      ],
      "description": "Default value for the field. Format depends on field type (e.g., 'true'/'false' for Checkbox, date string for Date fields)."
    },
    "visible_lines": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Visible Lines",
      "examples": [
        3,
        5,
        10
      ],
      "description": "Number of visible lines for LongTextArea fields in the UI. Typically 3-10."
    },
    "check_existing": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Check Existing",
      "default": true,
      "description": "If true, checks if the field already exists before attempting creation. Prevents errors when field is already present."
    },
    "field_api_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Field Api Name",
      "examples": [
        "Customer_Tier__c",
        "Priority_Level__c",
        "Contract_Value__c"
      ],
      "description": "The API name for the new custom field. Must end with '__c' for custom fields (e.g., 'Customer_Tier__c', 'Priority_Level__c')."
    },
    "object_api_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Object Api Name",
      "examples": [
        "Account",
        "Contact",
        "Opportunity",
        "Lead",
        "Invoice__c"
      ],
      "description": "The API name of the Salesforce object to add the field to (e.g., 'Account', 'Contact', 'Opportunity', or a custom object like 'Invoice__c')."
    },
    "picklist_values": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "PicklistValue",
        "required": [
          "full_name"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "label": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Label",
            "examples": [
              "High Priority",
              "Medium Priority",
              "Low Priority"
            ],
            "description": "The display label for this picklist value. If not specified, uses fullName as the label."
          },
          "default": {
            "type": "boolean",
            "title": "Default",
            "description": "If true, this value is the default selection for the picklist field."
          },
          "full_name": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Full Name",
            "examples": [
              "High",
              "Medium",
              "Low",
              "Active",
              "Inactive"
            ],
            "description": "The API name/value of the picklist entry (e.g., 'Option1', 'High', 'Active')."
          }
        },
        "description": "A single picklist value with its label and optional default setting."
      },
      "title": "Picklist Values",
      "examples": [
        [
          {
            "label": "High Priority",
            "default": true,
            "full_name": "High"
          },
          {
            "label": "Medium Priority",
            "full_name": "Medium"
          },
          {
            "label": "Low Priority",
            "full_name": "Low"
          }
        ]
      ],
      "description": "List of picklist values for Picklist or MultiselectPicklist fields. Each value must have at minimum a fullName."
    },
    "inline_help_text": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Inline Help Text",
      "examples": [
        "Select the appropriate tier based on annual contract value."
      ],
      "description": "Optional help text shown as a tooltip when users hover over the field in the UI."
    },
    "relationship_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Relationship Name",
      "examples": [
        "PrimaryContact",
        "ParentAccount",
        "RelatedInvoice"
      ],
      "description": "For Lookup fields, the API name for the relationship (used in queries). If not specified, Salesforce auto-generates one."
    },
    "visible_lines_picklist": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Visible Lines Picklist",
      "examples": [
        4,
        5,
        6
      ],
      "description": "For MultiselectPicklist fields, number of visible lines to display in the UI."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for creating a custom field via Tooling API."
}
```

## SALESFORCE_CREATE_CUSTOM_OBJECT
Tool to create a custom object in Salesforce using the Metadata API. Use when you need to dynamically create new object types (tables) in Salesforce with custom fields and configurations.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateCustomObjectRequest",
  "required": [
    "full_name",
    "label",
    "plural_label",
    "name_field"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "label": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Label",
      "examples": [
        "Invoice",
        "Student",
        "Custom Asset"
      ],
```

## SALESFORCE_CREATE_LEAD
Creates a new lead in Salesforce. `LastName` and `Company` are required. Org-level validation rules (e.g., email format, custom required fields) may reject requests beyond these; inspect the error response body for the failing field. The created lead `id` is returned in a response wrapper, not at the top level.

## SALESFORCE_CREATE_NOTE
Creates a new note attached to a Salesforce record with the specified title and content. Does not deduplicate — identical calls create duplicate notes. High-volume creation can trigger REQUEST_LIMIT_EXCEEDED; apply exponential backoff on retries.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateNoteRequest",
  "required": [
    "parent_id",
    "title"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "body": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Body",
      "default": "",
      "examples": [
        "Discussed product features and pricing. Customer is interested in premium plan.",
        "Called customer at 2pm. They requested a follow-up next week.",
        "Important: Contract expires on Dec 31st. Need to start renewal discussions."
      ],
      "description": "Body/content of the note. Can contain detailed text information.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Note Body",
      "human_parameter_description": "Write the main content of the note. Add details, decisions, and follow-ups you want to remember."
    },
    "title": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Title",
      "examples": [
        "Meeting Notes",
        "Call Summary",
        "Important Information",
        "Follow-up Required",
        "Customer Feedback"
      ],
      "description": "Title of the note (required field in Salesforce).",
      "human_parameter_name": "Title",
      "human_parameter_description": "What you want to call the note. Keep it short so it's easy to find later."
    },
    "owner_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Owner Id",
      "default": "",
      "examples": [
        "005XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"
      ],
      "description": "ID of the user who will own the note. Defaults to the current user if not specified.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Owner ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "Who should own this note. Enter a Salesforce User ID to assign it to someone else, or leave blank to assign it to yourself."
    },
    "parent_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Parent Id",
      "examples": [
        "001XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX",
        "003XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX",
        "00QXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX",
        "006XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"
      ],
      "description": "ID of the record to attach the note to (required field in Salesforce). Can be any record that supports notes like Account, Contact, Lead, Opportunity, etc.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Parent ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The record you want to attach this note to. Paste the Salesforce ID of the Account, Contact, Lead, Opportunity, or other record where the note should live."
    },
    "is_private": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Is Private",
      "default": false,
      "description": "Whether the note should be private (only visible to owner and users with Modify All Data permission).",
      "human_parameter_name": "Private Note",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose whether only you (and admins with full access) can see this note. Turn this on for sensitive information."
    },
    "custom_fields": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Custom Fields",
      "examples": [
        {
          "Category__c": "Meeting",
          "Priority__c": "High"
        },
        {
          "Custom_Field__c": "Custom Value"
        }
      ],
      "description": "Dictionary of custom field API names and their values. Custom field names typically end with '__c' (e.g., 'Priority__c', 'Category__c'). Use this to set any custom fields defined on the Note object in your Salesforce org.",
      "additionalProperties": true,
      "human_parameter_name": "Custom Fields",
      "human_parameter_description": "Add any custom fields your organization has defined for Notes. Enter field API names (ending in __c) and their values as key-value pairs."
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_CREATE_NOTE_RECORD_WITH_CONTENT_TYPE_HEADER
DEPRECATED: Creates a new Note record in Salesforce, associated with an existing Salesforce object via `ParentId`, automatically including a `Content-Type: application/json` header.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateNoteRecordWithContentTypeHeaderRequest",

        "Detailed notes from the meeting held on 2023-10-26.",

      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "Content or body of the note.",

      "human_parameter_description": "The main text of your note. Add the details you want to remember or share."
    },
    "Title": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Title",

        "Client Meeting Summary"
      ],
      "maxLength": 255,
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "Title of the note.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Note Title",
      "human_parameter_description": "A short, descriptive title for the note so it\u2019s easy to recognize later."
    },

      "type": "string",
```

```json
      "description": "Read-only. ID of the user who last modified this record. Auto-set by Salesforce.",
      "human_parameter_description": "Don\u2019t set this; Salesforce fills in who last updated the record."
    },
    "LastModifiedDate": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Last Modified Date",
      "format": "date-time",
      "description": "Read-only. Last modification timestamp. Auto-set by Salesforce.",
      "human_parameter_description": "Don\u2019t set this; Salesforce tracks when the record was last updated."
    },
    "attributes__type": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Attributes  Type",
      "description": "SObject type for this record, typically 'Opportunity'.",
      "human_parameter_description": "Usually 'Opportunity'; you can leave this blank unless you need to explicitly set the object type."
    },
    "TrackingNumber__c": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Tracking Number  C",
      "description": "Custom field: Associated tracking number.",
      "human_parameter_description": "Enter the shipment or tracking number related to this deal, if you have one."
    },
    "LastReferencedDate": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Last Referenced Date",
      "format": "date-time",
      "description": "Read-only. Timestamp of when current user last accessed this record or a related one. Not settable on creation.",
      "human_parameter_description": "No need to set this; Salesforce tracks when you last accessed this record or a related one."
    },
    "MainCompetitors__c": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Main Competitors  C",
      "description": "Custom field: Identified main competitors.",
      "human_parameter_description": "List the main competitors involved in this deal."
    },
    "LastStageChangeDate": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Last Stage Change Date",
      "format": "date-time",
      "description": "Read-only. Timestamp of last StageName change. Auto-set by Salesforce.",
      "human_parameter_description": "Don\u2019t set this; Salesforce updates it when the stage changes."
    },
    "CurrentGenerators__c": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Current Generators  C",
      "description": "Custom field: Information on current generators.",
      "human_parameter_description": "Note any existing solutions or vendors the customer currently uses."
    },
    "ForecastCategoryName": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Forecast Category Name",
      "examples": [
        "Omitted",
        "Pipeline",
        "Best Case",
        "Commit",
        "Closed"
      ],
      "description": "Name of the forecast category (e.g., 'Pipeline'). API v12.0+. Often implied by StageName but can be overridden. Typically determines ForecastCategory.",
      "human_parameter_description": "If your org uses named forecast categories, pick one (like Pipeline or Commit); otherwise it\u2019s inferred from the stage."
    },
    "HasOpportunityLineItem": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Has Opportunity Line Item",
      "description": "Read-only. Indicates if associated line items (products) exist. System-managed; ignored during creation.",
      "human_parameter_description": "You don\u2019t set this; Salesforce marks it true when products are added."
    },
    "TotalOpportunityQuantity": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Total Opportunity Quantity",
      "description": "Total quantity of items (e.g., units, licenses). Used in quantity-based forecasting.",
      "human_parameter_description": "Provide the total number of units or licenses you expect to sell for this deal, if relevant."
    },
    "LastAmountChangedHistoryId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Last Amount Changed History Id",
      "description": "Read-only. ID of OpportunityHistory record tracking last Amount change (API v50.0+). Not settable on creation.",
      "human_parameter_description": "Leave this blank; Salesforce uses it to reference the last change to Amount."
    },
    "DeliveryInstallationStatus__c": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Delivery Installation Status  C",
      "description": "Custom field: Delivery or installation status.",
      "human_parameter_description": "If you track delivery or installation, enter the current status in simple terms."
    },
    "LastCloseDateChangedHistoryId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Last Close Date Changed History Id",
      "description": "Read-only. ID of OpportunityHistory record tracking last CloseDate change (API v50.0+). Not settable on creation.",
      "human_parameter_description": "Leave this blank; Salesforce uses it to reference the last change to Close Date."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for creating a new Salesforce Opportunity record."
}
```

## SALESFORCE_CREATE_S_OBJECT_RECORD
Tool to create a new Salesforce SObject record. Use when you need to create any type of standard or custom Salesforce object record by specifying the object type and field values.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateSObjectRecordRequest",
  "required": [
    "sobject_type",
    "fields"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "fields": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Fields",
      "examples": [
        {
          "Name": "Acme Corp",
          "Industry": "Technology"
        },
        {
          "Email": "john@example.com",
          "LastName": "Doe",
          "FirstName": "John"
        },
        {
          "Name": "Q1 Deal",
          "CloseDate": "2024-12-31",
          "StageName": "Prospecting"
        }
      ],
      "description": "Dictionary of field API names and their values to set on the new record. Keys must be valid field API names for the specified object type. Required fields for the object must be included. Custom field names typically end with '__c'.",
      "additionalProperties": true
    },
    "sobject_type": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sobject Type",
      "examples": [
        "Account",
        "Contact",
        "Opportunity",
        "Lead",
        "Case",
        "Task"
      ],
      "description": "The API name of the Salesforce object type to create (e.g., 'Account', 'Contact', 'Opportunity', 'Lead', 'Case', 'Task'). This is case-sensitive and must match the exact API name in Salesforce."
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_CREATE_SOBJECT_TREE
Tool to create one or more sObject trees with root records of the specified type. Use when creating nested parent-child record hierarchies in a single atomic operation (e.g., Account with Contacts and Opportunities). Supports up to 200 total records across all trees, up to 5 levels deep, with maximum 5 different object types. All records succeed or all fail together.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateSobjectTreeRequest",
  "required": [
    "sobject_api_name",
    "records"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "records": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {},
      "title": "Records",
      "examples": [
        [
          {
            "Name": "Sample Account",
            "Phone": "555-1234",
            "Website": "www.example.com",
            "Contacts": {
              "records": [
                {
                  "Email": "john.doe@example.com",
                  "LastName": "Doe",
                  "FirstName": "John",
                  "attributes": {
                    "type": "Contact",
                    "referenceId": "ref2"
                  }
                }
              ]
            },
            "attributes": {
              "type": "Account",
              "referenceId": "ref1"
            }
          }
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Array of sObject record trees to create. Each record must include 'attributes' object with 'type' (matching sobject_api_name) and 'referenceId' fields, plus any standard or custom field values. Can include nested child records using relationship names (e.g., 'Contacts', 'Opportunities'). Constraints: Maximum 200 total records across all trees, maximum 5 levels deep, maximum 5 different object types."
    },
    "sobject_api_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sobject Api Name",
      "examples": [
        "Account",
        "Contact",
        "Opportunity"
      ],
      "description": "The API name of the sObject type for root records (e.g., Account, Contact, Opportunity). All root records in the request must be of this type."
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_CREATE_TASK
Creates a new task in Salesforce to track activities, to-dos, and follow-ups related to contacts, leads, or other records. Ensure who_id, what_id, and owner_id reference existing records before calling; invalid IDs cause silent linkage failures or validation errors.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateTaskRequest",
  "required": [
    "subject"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "status": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Status",
      "default": "Not Started",
      "examples": [
        "Not Started",
        "In Progress",
        "Completed",
        "Waiting on someone else",
        "Deferred"
      ],
      "description": "Status of the task. Must be a valid picklist value; arbitrary strings trigger validation errors.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Task Status",
      "human_parameter_description": "How far along the task is. Choose the current state so others know its progress."
    },
    "who_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Who Id",
      "default": "",
      "examples": [
        "003XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX",
        "00QXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"
      ],
      "description": "ID of the Contact or Lead this task is associated with. Only accepts Contact IDs (prefix '003') or Lead IDs (prefix '00Q'). Do NOT use Account/Opportunity/Case IDs here; use what_id for those. Swapping who_id and what_id creates orphaned tasks that won't appear on contact/lead timelines. Accepts only a single ID; create separate task records for multiple contacts.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Contact/Lead ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The contact or lead this task is about. Provide their Salesforce ID if you want the task tied to a specific person."
    },
    "subject": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Subject",
      "examples": [
        "Follow up on opportunity",
        "Call customer",
        "Send proposal",
        "Schedule meeting",
        "Review contract"
      ],
      "description": "Subject/title of the task.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Task Subject",
      "human_parameter_description": "The short title of the task you want to create. Make it clear so you can quickly recognize what needs to be done."
    },
    "what_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "What Id",
      "default": "",
      "examples": [
        "001XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX",
        "006XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX",
        "500XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"
      ],
      "description": "ID of the related record (Account, Opportunity, Case, etc.) this task is associated with. Accepts Account IDs (prefix '001'), Opportunity IDs (prefix '006'), Case IDs (prefix '500'), and other business object IDs.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Related Record ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The related record you want to associate with this task, like an account, opportunity, or case. Linking it helps keep the task in the right context."
    },
    "owner_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Owner Id",
      "default": "",
      "examples": [
        "005XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"
      ],
      "description": "ID of the user who owns the task. Defaults to current user if not specified.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Task Owner ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "Who should be responsible for this task. Leave blank to assign it to yourself, or enter another user's Salesforce ID."
    },
    "priority": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Priority",
      "default": "Normal",
      "examples": [
        "High",
        "Normal",
        "Low"
      ],
      "description": "Priority level of the task.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Task Priority",
      "human_parameter_description": "How important the task is compared to other work. Use this to signal urgency."
    },
    "description": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Description",
      "default": "",
      "examples": [
        "Call to discuss renewal options",
        "Follow up on pricing questions from last meeting",
        "Send updated proposal with discount options"
      ],
      "description": "Detailed description or notes for the task.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Task Description",
      "human_parameter_description": "Any notes or details that explain what needs to be done. Include context or next steps to make the task clear."
    },
    "activity_date": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Activity Date",
      "examples": [
        "2025-12-31",
        "2025-09-15"
      ],
      "description": "Due date for the task in YYYY-MM-DD format. Do not use full datetimes or natural-language strings like 'yesterday'; only YYYY-MM-DD is accepted.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Due Date",
      "human_parameter_description": "When the task should be completed, in YYYY-MM-DD format. Set a date to keep the task on schedule."
    },
    "custom_fields": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Custom Fields",
      "examples": [

          "Custom_Priority__c": "Critical",
          "Follow_Up_Required__c": true
        },
        {
          "External_ID__c": "EXT-12345"
        }
      ],
      "description": "Dictionary of custom field API names and their values. Custom field names typically end with '__c' (e.g., 'Priority_Level__c': 'Critical').",
      "additionalProperties": true,
      "human_parameter_name": "Custom Fields",
      "human_parameter_description": "Add any custom fields specific to your Salesforce org. Use the API name of each field (usually ending in '__c') as the key, and set its value."

      "human_parameter_description": "When the reminder should pop up, in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS format. Required only if you enable reminders."
    },
    "composio_execution_message": {

      "title": "Composio Execution Message",
      "description": "Internal field used to communicate processing details."
    }
  }
```

## SALESFORCE_DELETE_SOBJECT
Tool to delete a single Salesforce record by its ID. Use when you need to permanently remove a specific record from Salesforce. This operation is idempotent - deleting the same record multiple times returns success. Works with standard and custom objects.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "DeleteSobjectRequest",
  "required": [
    "sobject_name",
    "id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Id",
      "examples": [
        "001XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX",
        "003XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX",
        "006Wd000005FG3CIAW"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the record to delete. Must be a valid 15 or 18-character Salesforce ID format."
    },
    "sobject_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sobject Name",
      "examples": [
        "Account",
        "Contact",
        "Opportunity",
        "Lead",
        "CustomObject__c"
      ],
      "description": "The API name of the Salesforce object (sObject) to delete. Examples: Account, Contact, Opportunity, CustomObject__c. Must be a valid sObject type with proper permissions."
    }
  }
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "DeleteSobjectResponse": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "DeleteSobjectResponse",
      "properties": {},
      "description": "Response for DELETE sObject by ID. On success (HTTP 204), no body is returned."
    }
  },
  "title": "DeleteSobjectResponseWrapper",
  "required": [
    "data",
    "successful"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Data",
      "properties": {},
      "description": "Data from the action execution"
    },
    "error": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Error",
      "description": "Error if any occurred during the execution of the action"
    },
    "successful": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Successful",
      "description": "Whether or not the action execution was successful or not"
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_DELETE_SOBJECT_COLLECTIONS
Tool to delete up to 200 records in one request with optional rollback. Use when you need to delete multiple records efficiently, reducing API calls.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "DeleteSobjectCollectionsRequest",
  "required": [
    "ids"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Ids",
      "examples": [
        [
          "001xx000003DGb2AAG",
          "001xx000003DGb3AAG"
        ],
        [
          "003Wd000005NK4rIAG"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "List of record IDs to delete. Can specify up to 200 record IDs. Each ID should be a valid 15 or 18-character Salesforce ID."
    },
    "all_or_none": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "All Or None",
      "default": false,
      "examples": [
        false,
        true
      ],
      "description": "Specifies whether the operation should roll back if any record fails. When true, all records must be successfully deleted or the entire operation rolls back (atomic transaction). When false (default), partial success is allowed - successfully deleted records are committed even if some deletions fail."
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_EXECUTE_SOBJECT_QUICK_ACTION
Tool to execute a specific quick action on an sObject to create records with pre-configured defaults. Use when you need to leverage Salesforce Quick Actions to streamline record creation with field mappings and default values.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ExecuteSobjectQuickActionRequest",
  "required": [
    "sobject",
    "action_name",
    "record"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "record": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Record",
      "examples": [
        {
          "Status": "New",
          "Subject": "Child Case Created via Quick Action API",
          "Description": "This child case was created using the Quick Action endpoint."
        }
      ],
      "description": "Object containing field data for the record to be created. Field names and types depend on the target sObject and quick action configuration. Common fields include: Subject, Description, Status, Priority, etc.",
      "additionalProperties": true
    },
    "sobject": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sobject",
      "examples": [
        "Case",
        "Account",
        "Contact",
        "Lead",
        "Task"
      ],
      "description": "The API name of the sObject type (e.g., 'Account', 'Contact', 'Task', 'Lead', 'Case')."
    },
    "context_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Context Id",
      "examples": [
        "500dN00000JEW8MQAX",
        "001XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the context record. For object-specific actions, this provides the parent/related record context for the action execution."
    },
    "action_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Action Name",
      "examples": [
        "NewChildCase",
        "LogACall",
        "NewTask",
        "_LightningRelatedContact"
      ],
      "description": "The API name of the quick action to execute (e.g., 'LogACall', 'NewTask', 'NewChildCase')."
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_EXECUTE_SOQL_QUERY
DEPRECATED: Use SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY instead. Executes the provided SOQL query against Salesforce; the query must begin with 'SELECT'.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ExecuteSoqlQueryRequest",
  "required": [
    "soql_query"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "soql_query": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Soql Query",
      "examples": [
        "SELECT Id, Name, Email FROM Contact WHERE Name LIKE '%John%'",
        "SELECT Id, Name, Industry FROM Account WHERE Industry = 'Technology'",
        "SELECT Id, Name, Amount, StageName FROM Opportunity WHERE CloseDate = THIS_MONTH",
        "SELECT Id, Name, CreatedDate FROM Account WHERE CreatedDate >= 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z",
        "SELECT Id, Subject FROM Task WHERE CreatedDate >= 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z AND CreatedDate < 2024-12-31T23:59:59Z"
      ],
      "minLength": 10,
      "description": "The SOQL (Salesforce Object Query Language) query to execute. Example: 'SELECT Id, Name, Email FROM Contact WHERE Name LIKE '%John%' LIMIT 10'. Make sure to follow SOQL syntax and escape single quotes properly. IMPORTANT - DateTime field filtering: Datetime values MUST be in ISO-8601 format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ) and MUST NOT be enclosed in quotes. Examples: CreatedDate >= 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z, LastModifiedDate < 2024-12-31T23:59:59Z. You can also use date literals like TODAY, YESTERDAY, LAST_WEEK, THIS_MONTH, LAST_N_DAYS:30, etc. String values should be in single quotes, but datetime values should NOT be quoted.",
      "human_parameter_name": "SOQL Query",
      "human_parameter_description": "Type the Salesforce query you want to run to retrieve records. Start with SELECT and include any filters to get exactly the fields and results you need. For datetime fields, use ISO-8601 format (e.g., 2024-01-15T00:00:00Z) without quotes, or use date literals (TODAY, LAST_N_DAYS:30, etc.)."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `ExecuteSoqlQuery`"
}
```

## SALESFORCE_EXECUTE_SOSL_SEARCH
Execute a SOSL search to search across multiple Salesforce objects. Use when you need to search for text across multiple object types simultaneously.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ExecuteSoslSearchRequest",
  "required": [
    "q"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "q": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Q",
      "examples": [
        "FIND {test} IN ALL FIELDS RETURNING Account(Id, Name) LIMIT 5",
        "FIND {Acme} IN NAME FIELDS RETURNING Account(Name, Phone)",
        "FIND {john} RETURNING Contact(FirstName, LastName, Email)",
        "FIND {tech*} IN ALL FIELDS RETURNING Account(Name), Lead(Name, Company)"
      ],
      "description": "SOSL search query string to execute. Must follow SOSL syntax with FIND clause. Special characters and spaces must be URL-encoded. Example: 'FIND {Acme} IN ALL FIELDS RETURNING Account(Name, Phone), Contact(FirstName, LastName)'",
      "human_parameter_name": "Search Query",
      "human_parameter_description": "The SOSL search query to execute. Use FIND clause to specify search terms and RETURNING clause to specify objects and fields to retrieve."
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_GET_A_BATCH_OF_RECORDS
Tool to retrieve multiple Salesforce records in a single request with customizable field selection. Use when you need to fetch data for multiple records at once (up to 200 records).

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetABatchOfRecordsRequest",
  "required": [
    "record_ids"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "fields": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Fields",
      "examples": [
        "Account.Name,Account.Phone",
        "Contact.Email,Contact.Title"
      ],
      "description": "Comma-separated list of qualified field names to retrieve. Format: ObjectApiName.FieldName (e.g., 'Account.Name,Account.Phone'). If the user doesn't have access to a field, an error occurs. Either fields or optionalFields must be provided."
    },
    "record_ids": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Record Ids",
      "examples": [
        "001dN00000lvXx4QAE,001dN00000lvoUtQAI",
        "003xx000004TmiQAAS,001xx000003DGb2AAG"
      ],
      "description": "Comma-separated list of record IDs to retrieve. All record IDs must be from supported objects. Maximum 200 records per request."
    },
    "optional_fields": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Optional Fields",
      "examples": [
        "Account.AnnualRevenue,Contact.MailingAddress"
      ],
      "description": "Comma-separated list of qualified optional field names. Format: ObjectApiName.FieldName (e.g., 'Account.AnnualRevenue'). If the user doesn't have access to an optional field, it's excluded from the response without error. Can be used with fields parameter. Either fields or optionalFields must be provided."
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_GET_ACCOUNT
Retrieves a specific account by ID from Salesforce, returning all available fields.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetAccountRequest",
  "required": [
    "account_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "account_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Account Id",
      "examples": [
        "001Wd00000BSLklIAH",
        "001XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"
      ],
      "description": "The Salesforce ID of the account to retrieve.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Account ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The Salesforce ID of the account you want to retrieve. You can copy it from the account's URL in Salesforce (it usually starts with '001')."
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_GET_ALL_CUSTOM_OBJECTS
Retrieves all Salesforce objects (standard and custom) with detailed metadata. Each object includes a 'custom' field to identify custom objects. Use when you need to discover available objects or their capabilities.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetAllCustomObjectsRequest",
  "properties": {
    "page": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Page",
      "default": 1,
      "examples": [
        1,
        2,
        3
      ],
      "description": "Page number to retrieve (1-indexed). Defaults to 1. Must be at least 1."
    },
    "page_size": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Page Size",
      "default": 50,
      "examples": [
        25,
        50,
        100
      ],
      "description": "Number of objects to return per page. Defaults to 50. Must be between 1 and 200 (inclusive)."
    },
    "custom_only": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Custom Only",
      "default": false,
      "examples": [
        true,
        false
      ],
      "description": "If true, only returns custom objects (objects where custom=true). Defaults to false."
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_GET_ALL_FIELDS_FOR_OBJECT
Retrieves all fields (standard and custom) for a Salesforce object with complete metadata including field types, constraints, picklist values, and relationships.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetAllFieldsForObjectRequest",
  "required": [
    "object_name"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "object_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Object Name",
      "examples": [
        "Contact",
        "Account",
        "Lead",
        "Custom_Object__c"
      ],
      "description": "API name of the Salesforce object to describe. Use standard object names (Account, Contact, Lead, Opportunity) or custom object API names ending in __c.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Object Name",
      "human_parameter_description": "Enter the API name of the Salesforce object you want to inspect. Standard objects use names like 'Account' or 'Contact'. Custom objects end with '__c'."
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_GET_ALL_NAVIGATION_ITEMS
Gets all navigation items (tabs) that the user has access to. Use when you need to retrieve available navigation tabs for display or navigation purposes.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetAllNavigationItemsRequest",
  "properties": {
    "page": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Page",
      "default": 0,
      "examples": [
        0,
        1,
        2
      ],
      "description": "Page offset for paginated results. Default is 0. For example, page=2 with pageSize=10 returns items starting at position 21."
    },
    "pageSize": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Page Size",
      "default": 25,
      "examples": [
        10,
        25,
        50
      ],
      "description": "Maximum number of navigation items to return per page. Default is 25."
    },
    "formFactor": {
      "enum": [
        "Large",
        "Medium",
        "Small"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Form Factor",
      "default": "Large",
      "examples": [
        "Large",
        "Medium",
        "Small"
      ],
      "description": "Specifies the display size. Valid values: 'Large' (desktop, default), 'Medium' (tablet), or 'Small' (phone). Determines which navigation items are returned based on the form factor."
    },
    "navItemNames": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Nav Item Names",
      "examples": [
        "Home,Accounts,Contacts",
        "Opportunities,Leads"
      ],
      "description": "Comma-delimited list of TabDefinition name values to include in the response. If omitted, all navigation items for the specified form factor are returned."
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_GET_API
Tool to discover available REST API resources for a specified Salesforce API version. Use when you need to find available endpoints and their URIs for a specific API version.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "SalesforceGetApiRequest",
  "properties": {
    "version": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Version",
      "examples": [
        "v61.0",
        "v66.0",
        "v53.0"
      ],
      "description": "The Salesforce API version to query in format vXX.X (e.g., v61.0, v66.0). If not provided, uses the version from the authenticated connection."

  },

}
```

## SALESFORCE_GET_APP
Tool to get metadata about a specific Salesforce app by ID. Use when you need to retrieve app configuration details and navigation items for a particular application.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetAppRequest",
  "required": [
    "app_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "app_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "App Id",
      "examples": [
        "06mdN0000068CzKQAU",
        "0HD4J000000CaUzWAK"
      ],
      "description": "The 18-character ID of the app or the API name (developerName) of the app to retrieve.",
      "human_parameter_name": "App ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The unique Salesforce ID of the app you want to retrieve (starts with '06m' or '0HD') or the API name (developerName) of the app."
    },
    "form_factor": {
      "enum": [
        "Large",
        "Medium",
        "Small"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Form Factor",
      "examples": [
        "Large",
        "Medium",
        "Small"
      ],
      "description": "Specifies the device form factor for which to retrieve app metadata. 'Large' for desktop/web client (default), 'Medium' for tablet client, 'Small' for phone/mobile client.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Form Factor",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose the device type: Large (desktop/laptop), Medium (tablet), or Small (mobile phone). Leave blank for desktop configuration."
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_GET_APPS
Tool to get metadata for all apps a user has access to. Use when you need to list available Salesforce applications or check app navigation items. Metadata for the selected app includes tabs on the app's navigation bar, while other apps don't include tab details.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetAppsRequest",
  "properties": {
    "form_factor": {
      "enum": [
        "Large",
        "Medium",
        "Small"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Form Factor",
      "default": "Large",
      "examples": [
        "Large",
        "Medium",
        "Small"
      ],
      "description": "Specifies the form factor of the hardware/device the browser is running on. Determines which navigation items and metadata are returned. 'Large' for desktop/laptop, 'Medium' for tablets, 'Small' for mobile phones.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Form Factor",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose the device type: Large (desktop/laptop), Medium (tablet), or Small (mobile phone). This affects which navigation items are returned."
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_GET_CHILD_RECORDS
Tool to get child records for a specified parent record and child relationship name. Use when you need to retrieve related records from a parent-child relationship in Salesforce, such as getting all Contacts for an Account or all Opportunities for an Account. Results are paginated with configurable page size.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetChildRecordsRequest",
  "required": [
    "record_id",
    "relationship_name"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "fields": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Fields",
      "examples": [
        "Name,Email,Phone",
        "Title,Department,AccountId"
      ],
      "description": "Comma-separated list of API names of the related list's column fields to query. Supports spanning relationships in the format ObjectApiName.ChildRelationshipName.FieldApiName (e.g., Opportunity.Account.BillingAddress). If not specified, default fields are returned."
    },
    "page_size": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Page Size",
      "maximum": 2000,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        5,
        50,
        100
      ],
      "description": "The number of list records to return per page. The default value is 5 and the value can be 1-2000."
    },
    "record_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Record Id",
      "examples": [
        "001dN00000lvXx4QAE",
        "0015g00000XXXXXX"
      ],
      "description": "The unique 18-character Salesforce ID of the parent record. This is the record whose child records you want to retrieve."
    },
    "page_token": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Page Token",
      "examples": [
        "0"
      ],
      "description": "Token for pagination, used to navigate to a specific page of results. Obtained from the response's nextPageToken or previousPageToken fields."
    },
    "optional_fields": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Optional Fields",
      "examples": [
        "Description,CreatedDate",
        "LastModifiedDate,OwnerId"
      ],
      "description": "Comma-separated list of additional field API names in the related list to query. These are additional fields queried for the records returned that don't create visible columns. If the field is not available to the user, no error occurs."
    },
    "relationship_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Relationship Name",
      "examples": [
        "Contacts",
        "Opportunities",
        "Cases",
        "Tasks"
      ],
      "description": "The API name of the child relationship (typically the plural form of the child object name). Common examples include 'Contacts', 'Opportunities', 'Cases', 'Tasks'."
    }
  }
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "RecordData": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "RecordData",
      "properties": {
        "id": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Id",
          "description": "The unique 18-character Salesforce ID for the record."
        },
        "eTag": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "E Tag",
          "description": "ETag field for browser caching optimization."
        },
        "fields": {
          "type": "object",
```
