## SALESFORCE_GET_COMPACT_LAYOUTS
Tool to retrieve compact layout information for multiple Salesforce objects. Use when you need to display object data in compact form for Lightning Experience, mobile apps, or custom interfaces.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetCompactLayoutsRequest",
  "required": [
    "object_list"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "object_list": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Object List",
      "examples": [
        "Account",
        "Account,Contact",
        "Account,Contact,Lead"
      ],
      "description": "Comma-separated list of Salesforce object names to retrieve compact layouts for (e.g., 'Account', 'Account,Contact', 'Account,Contact,Lead')."
    }
  }
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "GetCompactLayoutsResponse": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "GetCompactLayoutsResponse",
      "properties": {},
      "description": "Response containing compact layout information for multiple Salesforce objects.",
      "additionalProperties": true
    }
  },
  "title": "GetCompactLayoutsResponseWrapper",
  "required": [
    "data",
    "successful"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Data",
      "properties": {},
      "description": "Data from the action execution",
      "additionalProperties": true
    },
    "error": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Error",
      "description": "Error if any occurred during the execution of the action"
    },
    "successful": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Successful",
      "description": "Whether or not the action execution was successful or not"
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_GET_COMPOSITE_RESOURCES
Tool to retrieve a list of available composite resources in Salesforce. Use when you need to discover which composite API endpoints are available for batch operations.

**Input schema:**
```json

  "title": "GetCompositeResourcesRequest",
  "properties": {},
  "description": "Request model for getting composite resources - no parameters needed."
}
```

```json
      "properties": {
        "tree": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Tree",
          "description": "URL path to the composite tree resource for creating parent-child sObject hierarchies (up to 200 records, 5 levels deep)."
        },

          "type": "string",
          "title": "Batch",
```

## SALESFORCE_GET_COMPOSITE_SOBJECTS
Retrieves multiple records of the same object type by IDs with a request body. Use when you need to retrieve more records than URL length limits allow (up to 2000 records vs ~800 via GET).

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "PostCompositeSobjectsRequest",
  "required": [
    "sobject_name",
    "ids",
    "fields"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Ids",
      "examples": [
        [
          "001xx000003DGb2AAG",
          "001xx000003DGb3AAG"
        ],
        [
          "001dN00000lvTdUQAU",
          "001dN00000lvTf2QAE"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Array of record IDs to retrieve. Maximum 2000 IDs per request.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Record IDs",
      "human_parameter_description": "A list of Salesforce record IDs to retrieve. You can get these IDs from record URLs or other API calls."
    },
    "fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Fields",
      "examples": [
        [
          "Id",
          "Name",
          "BillingCity",
          "Industry"
        ],
        [
          "Id",
          "Name",
          "Email",
          "Phone"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Array of field names to retrieve for each record. Specifies which fields to return in the response.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Fields to Retrieve",
      "human_parameter_description": "A list of field names you want to get back for each record. Include Id, Name, and any other fields you need."
    },
    "sobject_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sobject Name",
      "examples": [
        "Account",
        "Contact",
        "Lead",
        "Opportunity"
      ],
      "description": "The sObject type name (e.g., 'Account', 'Contact', 'Lead', 'Opportunity'). This specifies which type of records to retrieve.",
      "human_parameter_name": "sObject Type",
      "human_parameter_description": "The type of Salesforce records to retrieve, such as Account, Contact, Lead, or Opportunity."
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_GET_CONSENT_ACTION
Tool to retrieve aggregated consent preferences across multiple records for a specific action. Use when you need to check if users have consented to email, tracking, fax, or other actions across Contact, Lead, User, Person Account, or Individual objects.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetConsentActionRequest",
  "required": [
    "action",
    "ids"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "ids": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ids",
      "examples": [
        "003dN00000JnH4nQAF,003dN00000JnH4oQAF",
        "user@example.com,admin@example.com",
        "00Q5e00000ABC123"
      ],
      "description": "A comma-separated list of identifiers (email addresses or record IDs) for which consent data is being requested. These can be IDs of Lead, Contact, User, Person Account, or Individual records."
    },
    "action": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Action",
      "examples": [
        "email",
        "track",
        "fax",
        "shouldForget"
      ],
      "description": "The consent action to check. Common values include 'email', 'track', 'fax', or 'shouldForget'. This determines what type of consent preference is being queried."
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_GET_CONTACT
Retrieves a specific contact by ID from Salesforce, returning all available fields.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetContactRequest",
  "required": [
    "contact_id"
  ],
  "properties": {

      "type": "string",
      "title": "Fields",
      "examples": [
        "Name,Email,Phone",
        "FirstName,LastName,AccountId,Description"
      ],
      "description": "Comma-delimited string of Contact field API names to retrieve. If omitted, all fields are returned.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Contact Fields",
      "human_parameter_description": "Which contact details you want returned. Provide a comma-separated list of field names (like Name, Email, Phone) to get only those fields; leave blank to retrieve all fields."
    },
    "contact_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Contact Id",
      "examples": [
        "003XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"
      ],
      "description": "The Salesforce ID of the contact to retrieve. Must be a valid 18-character Salesforce ID; names or emails are not valid substitutes.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Contact ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The unique Salesforce ID of the contact you want to retrieve. Paste it from the contact's URL or use an ID from a previous search."
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_GET_CONTACT_BY_ID
Retrieves a Salesforce Contact by its unique ID; the ID must correspond to an existing Contact record in Salesforce.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetContactByIdRequest",
  "required": [
    "id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Id",
      "examples": [
        "003R0000005hDFYIA2",
        "0030K00002AmZYXQA3"
      ],
      "description": "The unique Salesforce ID of the Contact record to retrieve.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Contact ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The unique Salesforce ID of the contact you want to retrieve. Use the ID from a previous search or list to fetch that exact contact's details."
    },
    "fields": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Fields",
      "examples": [
        "Name,Email,Phone",
        "FirstName,LastName,AccountId,Description"
      ],
      "description": "Comma-delimited string of Contact field API names to retrieve. If omitted, a default set of fields is returned.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Contact Fields",
      "human_parameter_description": "Which contact details you want returned. Provide a comma-separated list of field names (like Name, Email, Phone) to get only those fields; leave blank to use the default set."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for retrieving a Salesforce Contact by ID."
}
```

## SALESFORCE_GET_DASHBOARD
Gets detailed metadata for a specific dashboard including its components, layout, and filters.

## SALESFORCE_GET_FILE_CONTENT
Returns the binary content of a Salesforce file, including references to external files. Use when you need to download or retrieve the actual file data from Salesforce.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetFileContentRequest",
  "required": [
    "file_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "file_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "File Id",
      "examples": [
        "069dN000005L75FQAS",
        "069XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"
      ],
      "description": "The 18-character Salesforce ID of the ContentDocument or ContentVersion file to retrieve."
    },
    "version_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Version Id",
      "examples": [
        "068dN000005L75FQAS",
        "068XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"
      ],
      "description": "Specifies a particular version of the file to retrieve. If not specified, returns the latest version."
    },
    "rendition_type": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Rendition Type",
      "examples": [
        "THUMB120BY90",
        "THUMB240BY180",
        "ORIGINAL_Pdf"
      ],
      "description": "Specifies the type of file rendition to return. Available values: THUMB120BY90, THUMB240BY180, THUMB720BY480, SVGZ, ORIGINAL_<File_Extension>."
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_GET_FILE_INFORMATION
Tool to retrieve comprehensive metadata and information about a specified file in Salesforce. Use when you need detailed file information including ownership, sharing settings, download URLs, and rendition status.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetFileInformationRequest",
  "required": [
    "file_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "file_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "File Id",
      "examples": [
        "069dN000005L1GrQAK",
        "069xx000000001AAAQ"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier for the file - 18-character Salesforce ID (ContentDocument ID or ContentVersion ID). Example: 069xx000000001AAAQ"
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_GET_GLOBAL_ACTIONS
Tool to retrieve actions displayed in the Salesforce Global Actions menu with metadata. Use when you need to discover available global actions, quick actions, or custom buttons in the UI.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetGlobalActionsRequest",
  "properties": {
    "apiNames": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Api Names",
      "examples": [
        "NewTask,NewEvent",
        "LogACall"
      ],
      "description": "Comma-separated list of action API names to filter results (e.g., 'NewTask,NewEvent,LogACall')."
    },
    "formFactor": {
      "enum": [
        "Large",
        "Medium",
        "Small"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Form Factor",
      "examples": [
        "Large",
        "Medium",
        "Small"
      ],
      "description": "Device form factor to filter actions. Valid values: 'Large' (Desktop), 'Medium' (Tablet), 'Small' (Mobile)."
    },
    "actionTypes": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Action Types",
      "examples": [
        "QuickAction",
        "StandardButton,QuickAction"
      ],
      "description": "Comma-separated list of action types to filter (e.g., 'StandardButton,QuickAction,CustomButton,ProductivityAction')."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for getting global actions."
}
```

## SALESFORCE_GET_JOB_FAILED_RECORD_RESULTS
Tool to retrieve failed records from a Salesforce Bulk API 2.0 ingest job. Use when you need to get records that failed during a bulk operation, including error messages and original data.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetJobFailedRecordResultsRequest",
  "required": [
    "job_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "job_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Job Id",
      "examples": [
        "750dN00000BIUUMQA5",
        "750XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the bulk ingest job."
    },
    "locator": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Locator",
      "examples": [
        "MTAwMDA"
      ],
      "description": "Pagination token from the Sforce-Locator response header of a previous request, used to retrieve the next set of results."
    },
    "max_records": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Max Records",
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        1000,
        5000
      ],
      "description": "The maximum number of records to retrieve per page. If omitted, the API returns the maximum number of records it can send in a single page."
    }
  }
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "GetJobFailedRecordResultsResponse": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "GetJobFailedRecordResultsResponse",
      "required": [
        "csv_data"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "csv_data": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Csv Data",
```

## SALESFORCE_GET_LEAD
Retrieves a specific lead by ID from Salesforce, returning all available fields.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetLeadRequest",
  "required": [
    "lead_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "lead_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Lead Id",
      "examples": [
        "00QWd000005V3RmMAK",
        "00QXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"
      ],
      "description": "The Salesforce ID of the lead to retrieve. Must be a Salesforce record ID (18-char format like '00QWd000005V3RmMAK'); names, emails, or external codes are not accepted \u2014 resolve to a Salesforce ID first using a search or query tool.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Lead ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The unique Salesforce ID of the lead you want to retrieve. You can find it in the lead\u2019s URL\u2014it usually starts with '00Q'."
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_GET_LIST_VIEW_METADATA_BY_NAME
Returns list view metadata by object and list view API name. Use when you need to retrieve complete metadata information for a specific list view, including display columns, filters, sort order, permissions, and user preferences.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetListViewMetadataByNameRequest",
  "required": [
    "sobject_api_name",
    "list_view_api_name"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "sobject_api_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sobject Api Name",
      "examples": [
        "Account",
        "Contact",
        "Opportunity",
        "Lead",
        "Case"
      ],
      "description": "The API name of a supported Salesforce object."
    },
    "list_view_api_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "List View Api Name",
      "examples": [
        "AllAccounts",
        "MyOpportunities",
        "RecentlyViewedLeads"
      ],
      "description": "The API name of the list view."
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_GET_LIST_VIEW_RECORDS_BY_ID
Returns record data for a list view by its ID. Use when you need to retrieve records from a specific Salesforce list view.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetListViewRecordsPerIdRequest",
  "required": [
    "list_view_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "fields": {

    },

      "examples": [
        "Name",
        "-CreatedDate",
        "Email"
      ],

    },

      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Page Size",
      "maximum": 2000,
      "minimum": 1,
      "description": "The number of list records viewed at one time. Default value is 50. Value can be 1-2000."
    },

      "title": "Page Token",

    },
    "list_view_id": {

      "title": "List View Id",
      "examples": [
        "00BdN00000Dqx2wUAB",
        "00B1a2b3c4d5e6f7g8"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the list view to retrieve records from."
    },
    "optional_fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Optional Fields",
      "description": "Additional fields queried for the records returned. These fields don't create visible columns. If the field is not available to the user, no error occurs and the field isn't included in the records."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for getting list view records by list view ID."
}
```

## SALESFORCE_GET_LIST_VIEW_RECORDS_BY_NAME
Retrieves paginated record data for a specified list view using the object and list view API names. Use when you need to fetch records that match a specific list view's filters and sorting criteria. Returns the same data that powers Lightning Experience list views.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetListViewRecordsByNameRequest",
  "required": [
    "sobject_api_name",
    "list_view_api_name"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "where": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Where",
      "description": "Filter applied to returned records in GraphQL syntax."
    },
    "fields": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Fields",
      "description": "Comma-separated list of additional fields to query for the records returned. If a field is not available to the user, an error occurs. Example: 'Industry,AnnualRevenue,Description'"
    },
    "sortBy": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sort By",
      "description": "The API name of the field to sort by. Prefix with '-' for descending order. Examples: 'Name', '-CreatedDate'"
    },
    "pageSize": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Page Size",
      "maximum": 2000,
      "minimum": 1,
      "description": "Number of list records to return per page. Default: 50. Valid range: 1-2000."
    },
    "pageToken": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Page Token",
      "description": "Token representing the page offset for pagination. Obtained from nextPageToken in previous responses."
    },
    "searchTerm": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Search Term",
      "description": "A search term to filter results. Wildcards are supported."
    },
    "optionalFields": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Optional Fields",
      "description": "Comma-separated list of additional fields queried for the records. If a field is not available to the user, no error occurs and the field is not included. Example: 'CustomField__c,Phone'"
    },
    "sobject_api_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sobject Api Name",
      "examples": [
        "Account",
        "Contact",
        "Opportunity",
        "Lead",
        "Case"
      ],
      "description": "The API name of a supported Salesforce object (e.g., 'Account', 'Contact', 'Opportunity', 'Lead', 'Case')."
    },
    "list_view_api_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "List View Api Name",
      "examples": [
        "AllAccounts",
        "MyAccounts",
        "RecentlyViewedOpportunities"
      ],
      "description": "The API name of a list view (e.g., 'AllAccounts', 'MyAccounts') or the 18-character list view ID."
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_GET_LIST_VIEW_RESULTS
Retrieves the results of a list view for a specified sObject. Returns column definitions and record data with a 2,000 record limit per response.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetListViewResultsRequest",
  "required": [
    "sobject",
    "list_view_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "sobject": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sobject",
      "examples": [
        "Account",
        "Contact",
        "Opportunity",
        "Lead"
      ],
      "description": "The API name of the Salesforce object (e.g., 'Account', 'Contact', 'Opportunity')."
    },
    "list_view_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "List View Id",
      "examples": [
        "00BdN00000Dqx2wUAB",
        "00B3000000ABC123"
      ],
      "description": "The unique 18-character ID of the list view to retrieve results from."
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_GET_LOOKUP_FIELD_SUGGESTIONS
Tool to retrieve lookup field suggestions for editing lookup fields with search filtering. Use when searching for records to populate a lookup field, supporting typeahead, recent, and full-text search.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetLookupFieldSuggestionsRequest",
  "required": [
    "object_api_name",
    "field_api_name"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "q": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Q",
      "examples": [
        "ta",
        "acme",
        "john"
      ],
      "description": "Search query string used to filter and find matching records. Use for typeahead search."
    },
    "page": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Page",
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        1,
        2,
        3
      ],
      "description": "Page number for pagination of results."
    },
    "page_size": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Page Size",
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        10,
        25,
        50
      ],
      "description": "Number of records to return per page."
    },
    "form_factor": {
      "enum": [
        "Large",
        "Medium",
        "Small"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Form Factor",
      "examples": [
        "Large",
        "Medium",
        "Small"
      ],
      "description": "Device form factor: 'Large' for desktop, 'Medium' for tablet, 'Small' for mobile."
    },
    "search_type": {
      "enum": [
        "Recent",
        "Search",
        "TypeAhead"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Search Type",
      "examples": [
        "TypeAhead",
        "Recent",
        "Search"
      ],
      "description": "Type of search to perform: 'Recent' for most recently used matches, 'Search' for any match in searchable fields, 'TypeAhead' for matching names."
    },
    "field_api_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Field Api Name",
      "examples": [
        "AccountId",
        "OwnerId",
        "ContactId"
      ],
      "description": "API name of the lookup field on the source object (e.g., 'AccountId', 'OwnerId')."
    },
    "object_api_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Object Api Name",
      "examples": [
        "Opportunity",
        "Account",
        "Contact",
        "Case"
      ],
      "description": "API name of the object containing the lookup field (e.g., 'Opportunity', 'Account', 'Contact')."
    },
    "dependent_field_bindings": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Dependent Field Bindings",
      "examples": [
        "{\"Region__c\":\"West\"}",
        "{\"Status__c\":\"Active\"}"
      ],
      "description": "Lookup filter bindings for dependent lookups, specified as JSON string with field-value pairs for filtering."
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_GET_LOOKUP_SUGGESTIONS_CASE_CONTACT
Tool to get lookup field suggestions with POST request. Use when editing lookup fields with dependent lookup filtering or when you need to pass source record context in the request body.

**Input schema:**

## SALESFORCE_GET_MRU_LIST_VIEW_METADATA
Tool to retrieve MRU list view metadata for a Salesforce object. Use when you need to understand the structure and configuration of the most recently used list view for an object.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetMruListViewMetadataRequest",
  "required": [
    "sobject_api_name"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "sobject_api_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sobject Api Name",
      "examples": [
        "Account",
        "Contact",
        "Opportunity",
        "CustomObject__c"
      ],
      "description": "The API name of the Salesforce object to retrieve MRU list view metadata for."
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_GET_MRU_LIST_VIEW_RECORDS
Tool to retrieve record data for an object's most recently used (MRU) list view. Use when you need to get the records that a user has recently accessed for a specific Salesforce object type.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetMruListViewRecordsRequest",
  "required": [
    "sobject_api_name"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "fields": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Fields",
      "examples": [
        "Name,Phone,Email",
        "CreatedDate,LastModifiedDate"
      ],
      "description": "Comma-separated list of additional fields to query for returned records. An error occurs if a field is unavailable to the user."
    },
    "sort_by": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sort By",
      "examples": [
        "CreatedDate",
        "-CreatedDate",
        "Name",
        "-LastModifiedDate"
      ],
      "description": "API name of the field to sort by. Prefix with '-' for descending order (e.g., 'CreatedDate' for ascending, '-CreatedDate' for descending)."
    },
    "page_size": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Page Size",
      "maximum": 2000,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        50,
        100,
        200
      ],
      "description": "Number of list records to view at one time. Default is 50, minimum is 1, maximum is 2000."
    },
    "page_token": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Page Token",
      "description": "Token representing the page offset for pagination to retrieve subsequent pages of results."
    },
    "optional_fields": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Optional Fields",
      "examples": [
        "Name,Phone,Email",
        "CreatedDate,LastModifiedDate"
      ],
      "description": "Comma-separated list of additional fields to query for returned records. No error occurs if a field is unavailable to the user."
    },
    "sobject_api_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sobject Api Name",
      "examples": [
        "Account",
        "Contact",
        "Opportunity",
        "Lead",
        "Case"
      ],
      "description": "The API name of the Salesforce object to retrieve MRU list view records for (e.g., 'Account', 'Contact', 'Opportunity')."
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_GET_NOTE
Retrieves a specific note by ID from Salesforce, returning all available fields. Notes with IsPrivate=true require the integration user to have sufficient permissions; inaccessible private notes will not be returned.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetNoteRequest",
  "required": [
    "note_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "note_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Note Id",
      "examples": [
        "002Wd000001UYbaIAG",
        "002XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"
      ],
      "description": "The Salesforce ID of the note to retrieve.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Note ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The Salesforce ID of the note you want to retrieve. You can copy this from the note's URL or from a previous list or search result."
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_GET_PHOTO_ACTIONS
Tool to retrieve available photo actions for Salesforce pages. Use when you need to get photo management actions for user or group pages. Currently, only group and user pages support photo actions.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetPhotoActionsRequest",
  "required": [
    "record_ids"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "record_ids": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Record Ids",
      "examples": [
        "005dN000009GN8LQAW",
        "005dN000009GN8LQAW,005dN000009GN8MQAW"
      ],
      "description": "The record ID(s) for which to retrieve photo actions. Can be a single User ID or Group ID, or comma-separated list of IDs."
    },
    "form_factor": {
      "enum": [
        "Large",
        "Medium",
        "Small"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Form Factor",
      "description": "Specifies the device form factor for which to return actions. Large for Desktop/laptop, Medium for Tablet, Small for Mobile phone screens. If not specified, returns actions for all form factors."
    },
    "action_types": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Action Types",
      "examples": [
        "QuickAction",
        "QuickAction,StandardButton"
      ],
      "description": "Filters the types of actions to return. Can be a single value or comma-separated list. Valid values: StandardButton, QuickAction, CustomButton, ProductivityAction."
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_GET_PICKLIST_VALUES_BY_RECORD_TYPE
Tool to get values for all picklist fields of a record type, including dependent picklists. Use when you need to retrieve available picklist options for a specific object and record type, especially for dependent picklist hierarchies.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetValuesForAllPicklistFieldsOfARecordTypeRequest",
  "required": [
    "sobject_api_name",
    "record_type_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "record_type_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Record Type Id",
      "examples": [
        "012000000000000AAA",
        "012xx0000000000AAA"
      ],
      "description": "The 18-character Record Type ID. Use '012000000000000AAA' for objects without record types (default record type)."
    },
    "sobject_api_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sobject Api Name",
      "examples": [
        "Account",
        "Contact",
        "Opportunity",
        "Car__c"
      ],
      "description": "The API name of the Salesforce object (e.g., 'Account', 'Contact', 'Opportunity', or custom object like 'Car__c')."
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_GET_QUERY_JOB_RESULTS
Retrieves results for a completed Bulk API v2 query job in CSV format. Supports pagination for large datasets via maxRecords and locator parameters.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetQueryJobResultsRequest",
  "required": [
    "job_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "job_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Job Id",
      "examples": [
        "750dN00000BIPXuQAP",
        "750XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"
      ],
      "description": "The unique 18-character identifier for the query job whose results you want to retrieve."
    },
    "locator": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Locator",
      "description": "A Base64-encoded string used for pagination to retrieve the next set of records. This value is obtained from the Sforce-Locator response header of the previous request. Use this to traverse through subsequent pages of results."
    },
    "max_records": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Max Records",
      "examples": [
        1000,
        5000,
        10000
      ],
      "description": "Defines the number of records to be downloaded per page. If omitted, the API returns the maximum number of records it can send in a single page. Used to control page size for pagination."
    }
  }
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "GetQueryJobResultsResponse": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "GetQueryJobResultsResponse",
      "required": [
        "csv_data"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "csv_data": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Csv Data",
          "description": "The query results in CSV format. The first row contains field names (column headers), and subsequent rows contain the record data."
        },
        "content_type": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Content Type",
          "description": "The content type of the response, typically 'text/csv' for query results."
        },
        "sforce_locator": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Sforce Locator",
          "description": "A Base64-encoded locator value from the response header that acts as an OFFSET pointer to the next set of records. When present and not null, indicates more records are available. Use this value in the locator parameter of the next request. When null or absent, all records have been retrieved."
        }
      },
      "description": "Response from retrieving query job results in CSV format."
    }
  },
  "title": "GetQueryJobResultsResponseWrapper",
  "required": [
    "data",
    "successful"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Data",
      "required": [
        "csv_data"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "csv_data": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Csv Data",
          "description": "The query results in CSV format. The first row contains field names (column headers), and subsequent rows contain the record data."
        },
        "content_type": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Content Type",
          "description": "The content type of the response, typically 'text/csv' for query results."
        },
        "sforce_locator": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Sforce Locator",
          "description": "A Base64-encoded locator value from the response header that acts as an OFFSET pointer to the next set of records. When present and not null, indicates more records are available. Use this value in the locator parameter of the next request. When null or absent, all records have been retrieved."
        }
      },
      "description": "Data from the action execution"
    },
    "error": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Error",
      "description": "Error if any occurred during the execution of the action"
    },
```

## SALESFORCE_GET_RECORD_EDIT_PAGE_ACTIONS
Tool to get available actions on record edit pages. Use when you need to retrieve metadata about actions (standard actions, custom actions, quick actions, productivity actions) displayed on the record edit page for specific records.

```json
        "001dN00000lvXx4QAE",
        "001R0000003IDlwIAG,001dN00000lvXx4QAE"

      "description": "Comma-separated list of 18-character Salesforce record IDs for which to retrieve record edit actions. Multiple IDs can be provided to retrieve actions for multiple records in a single request."

        "Medium",
        "Small"

      "type": "string",
      "title": "Action Types",
      "examples": [
        "Standard",
        "QuickAction",
        "Standard,Custom"
      ],
      "description": "Comma-separated list of action types to filter results. Common values include: 'Standard', 'Custom', 'QuickAction', 'ProductivityAction', 'DefaultButton'."
    },
    "retrieval_mode": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Retrieval Mode",
      "description": "Specifies how actions should be retrieved to control the retrieval behavior for actions."
    }
  }
}
```

```json
      "title": "Related List Ids",
```

```json
        "Account.Contacts",
        "Opportunity.Cases,Contact.Tasks"
      ],
      "description": "Comma-separated list of related list IDs. Each ID follows the format 'objectApiName.relatedListId' (e.g., 'Account.Contacts,Account.Opportunities')."
```

## SALESFORCE_GET_RELATED_LIST_RECORDS_CONTACTS
Tool to retrieve related list records with request body parameters for filtering and pagination. Use when you need to get records from a related list associated with a parent record with complex query parameters. Returns up to 1,999 records per related list with pagination support.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetRelatedListRecordsContactsRequest",
  "required": [
    "parent_record_id",
    "related_list_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "where": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Where",
      "examples": [
        "{LastName: {like: 'S%'}}"
      ],
      "description": "Filter to apply to related list records, written in GraphQL syntax (e.g., '{Name: {like: \"A%\"}}'). Note: Semi-joins and anti-joins filters are currently not supported."
    },
    "fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Fields",
      "examples": [
        [
          "Contact.Id",
          "Contact.Name",
          "Contact.Email"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "The API names of the related list's column fields to query. Supports spanning relationships using dot notation (e.g., 'Opportunity.Account.Name')."
    },
    "sort_by": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Sort By",
      "examples": [
        [
          "Contact.Name"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "An array of field API names to sort the related list by. Important: Despite being an array, it accepts only ONE value per request."
    },
    "page_size": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Page Size",
      "maximum": 1999,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        10,
        50,
        100
      ],
      "description": "The number of list records to return per page. Default: 50. Range: 1-1999."
    },
    "page_token": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Page Token",
      "description": "Token for pagination to navigate to a specific page of results. Obtained from nextPageToken or previousPageToken in previous responses."
    },
    "optional_fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Optional Fields",
      "examples": [
        [
          "Contact.Phone"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "API names of additional fields in the related list that don't create visible columns. If a field is not available to the user, no error occurs - it's simply omitted from the response."
    },
    "related_list_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Related List Id",
      "examples": [
        "Contacts",
        "Opportunities",
        "Cases"
      ],
      "description": "The API name of the related list or child relationship (e.g., 'Contacts', 'Opportunities', 'Cases'). This is typically the plural form of the object name."
    },
    "parent_record_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Parent Record Id",
      "examples": [
        "001xx000003GYOpAAO",
        "001dN00000lvODrQAM"
      ],
      "description": "The 18-character Salesforce ID of the parent record for which to retrieve related lists (e.g., Account ID, Opportunity ID)."
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_GET_REPORT
Gets detailed metadata for a specific report including its structure, columns, filters, and groupings. Only fields included in the report layout are returned; use SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY when specific fields outside the report layout are required.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetReportRequest",
  "required": [
    "report_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "report_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Report Id",
      "examples": [
        "00OWd000001GtZ9MAK",
        "00OXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"
      ],
      "description": "The Salesforce ID of the report to retrieve metadata for.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Report ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The unique Salesforce ID of the report you want metadata for. Copy it from the report's URL (report IDs typically start with '00O')."
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_GET_REPORT_INSTANCE
Gets the results of a report instance created by running a report. Poll `attributes.status` until it equals 'Success' before parsing results. Response data is nested under `factMap` and `reportExtendedMetadata`; an empty `factMap` or zero rows is a valid successful result, not an error.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetReportInstanceRequest",
  "required": [
    "report_id",
    "instance_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "report_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Report Id",
      "examples": [
        "00OWd000001GtZ9MAK",
        "00OXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"
      ],
      "description": "The Salesforce ID of the report.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Report ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The ID of the report you ran and want results for. You can find this in the report\u2019s URL in Salesforce when viewing the report."
    },
    "instance_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Instance Id",
      "examples": [
        "0LGWd000000MWUIOA4",
        "0LGXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"
      ],
      "description": "The report instance ID returned from running a report.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Instance ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The specific run of the report whose results you want to fetch. This ID is returned when you run the report and create an instance."
    }
  }
}
```

Retrieves search result layout information for specified sObjects. Use when you need to understand which fields are displayed in search results for objects.

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetSearchLayoutRequest",
  "required": [
    "object_names"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "object_names": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Object Names",
      "examples": [
        "Account",
        "Account,Contact",
        "Lead,Opportunity,Account,Contact",
        "Case,CustomObject__c"
      ],
      "description": "Comma-separated list of sObject API names for which to retrieve search layouts (e.g., 'Account,Contact'). Can include standard objects (Account, Contact, Lead, Opportunity, Case) and custom objects (CustomObject__c)."

}
```

## SALESFORCE_GET_SEARCH_SUGGESTIONS
Returns a list of suggested searches based on the user's query string. Use when you want to help users discover relevant search terms before performing a search.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetSearchSuggestionsRequest",
  "required": [
    "q",
    "channel",
    "language"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "q": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Q",
      "examples": [
        "sales",
        "account",
        "contact"
      ],
      "description": "The search query string for which to return suggested queries. This is the partial text input from the user.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Query String",
      "human_parameter_description": "The partial search text to get suggestions for. Enter what you're looking for and get suggested complete queries."
    },
    "channel": {
      "enum": [
        "Pkb",
        "Csp",
        "Prm",
        "App"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Channel",
      "examples": [
        "Pkb",
        "Csp",
        "Prm",
        "App"
      ],
      "description": "The channel context for the search suggestions. Valid values: 'Pkb' (Public Knowledge Base), 'Csp' (Customer Service Portal), 'Prm' (Partner Portal), 'App' (Internal Application).",
      "human_parameter_name": "Channel",
      "human_parameter_description": "The Knowledge channel to search in: 'Pkb' for Public Knowledge Base, 'Csp' for Customer Portal, 'Prm' for Partner Portal, or 'App' for Internal Application."
    },
    "sobject": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sobject",
      "examples": [
        "Account",
        "Contact",
        "Opportunity",
        "Lead"
      ],
      "description": "The Salesforce object type to focus the suggestions on. Limits suggestions to queries relevant to specific object types.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Object Type",
      "human_parameter_description": "Focus suggestions on a specific Salesforce object type (e.g., 'Account', 'Contact'). Leave blank for general suggestions."
    },
    "language": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Language",
      "examples": [
        "en_US",
        "fr_FR",
        "de_DE",
        "es_ES"
      ],
      "description": "The language for the search suggestions. Required parameter. Use standard locale codes (e.g., 'en_US', 'fr_FR').",
      "human_parameter_name": "Language",
      "human_parameter_description": "The language locale for suggestions (e.g., 'en_US' for English). This is a required parameter."
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_GET_SOBJECT_BY_EXTERNAL_ID
Tool to retrieve a Salesforce record by matching an external ID field value. Use when you need to find a record using a custom external identifier instead of the Salesforce ID. The field specified must be marked as an External ID in Salesforce.

```json
        "Contact",

      "title": "Field Name",
      "examples": [
        "External_ID__c",
        "Email",
```

```json
        "001xx000003DGb2AAG"
```

## SALESFORCE_GET_S_OBJECT_RECORD
Tool to retrieve a single Salesforce record by ID from any sObject type. Use when you need to get detailed information about a specific record.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetSObjectRecordRequest",
  "required": [
    "sobject_api_name",
    "record_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "fields": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Fields",
      "examples": [
        "Name,Id,CreatedDate",
        "FirstName,LastName,Email,Phone"
      ],
      "description": "Comma-separated list of field names to retrieve from the record. If omitted, all fields are returned. Example: Name,Id,CreatedDate,Industry"
    },
    "record_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Record Id",
      "examples": [
        "001dN00000lvXx4QAE",
        "003XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"
      ],
      "description": "The unique Salesforce record ID (15 or 18 characters). The 3-character prefix indicates the object type (e.g., '001' for Account, '003' for Contact, '00Q' for Lead). Ensure the sobject_api_name matches the record ID prefix."
    },
    "sobject_api_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sobject Api Name",
      "examples": [
        "Account",
        "Contact",
        "Opportunity",
        "Lead",
        "Custom__c"
      ],
      "description": "The API name of the Salesforce sObject type (e.g., Account, Contact, Opportunity, Custom__c). Object names are not case-sensitive. Ensure the sObject type matches the record ID prefix (e.g., Account IDs start with '001', Contact with '003', Lead with '00Q')."
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_GET_SOBJECT_RELATIONSHIP
Retrieves records by traversing sObject relationships using friendly URLs. Use when you need to get related records through a relationship field (e.g., all Contacts for an Account).

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetSobjectRelationshipRequest",
  "required": [
    "sobject",
    "id",
    "relationship_field_name"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Id",
      "examples": [
        "001dN00000lvXx4QAE",
        "003D000000IroHJ"
      ],
      "description": "The 15 or 18-character Salesforce ID of the parent record."
    },
    "fields": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Fields",
      "examples": [
        "Id,Name,Email",
        "Name,Amount,StageName"
      ],
      "description": "Comma-separated list of fields to retrieve from the related records. If not specified, returns default fields."
    },
    "sobject": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sobject",
      "examples": [
        "Account",
        "Contact",
        "Opportunity"
      ],
      "description": "The parent sObject type (e.g., 'Account', 'Contact', 'Opportunity'). Must be a valid Salesforce object type."
    },
    "relationship_field_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Relationship Field Name",
      "examples": [
        "Contacts",
        "Opportunities",
        "Cases"
      ],
      "description": "The name of the relationship field to traverse (e.g., 'Contacts' for Account.Contacts, 'Opportunities' for Account.Opportunities)."
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_GET_S_OBJECTS_DESCRIBE_LAYOUTS_RECORD_TYPE_ID
Tool to retrieve layout metadata for a specific record type on an object. Use when you need detailed information about page layouts, field positioning, sections, quick actions, related lists, and buttons for a particular record type.

```json
  "title": "GetSObjectsDescribeLayoutsRecordTypeIdRequest",

    "sobject",
    "record_type_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "sobject": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sobject",
      "examples": [
        "Account",
        "Contact",
        "Opportunity",
        "CustomObject__c"
      ],
      "description": "The API name of the Salesforce object to retrieve layout information for."

      "examples": [
        "012000000000000AAA",
        "012XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"

  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_GET_S_OBJECTS_UPDATED
Tool to retrieve a list of sObject records that have been updated within a given timeframe. Use when you need to synchronize records or track changes to specific sObject types over a time period.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetSObjectsUpdatedRequest",
  "required": [
    "sobject",
    "start",
    "end"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "end": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "End",
      "examples": [
        "2025-12-23T23:59:59Z",
        "2025-12-31T23:59:59Z"
      ],
      "description": "End of the timeframe for which to retrieve updated records. Must be in ISO 8601 format (e.g., 2025-12-23T23:59:59Z). The date range between start and end cannot exceed 30 days."
    },
    "start": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Start",
      "examples": [
        "2025-12-23T10:22:26Z",
        "2025-12-01T00:00:00Z"
      ],
      "description": "Start of the timeframe for which to retrieve updated records. Must be in ISO 8601 format (e.g., 2025-12-23T10:22:26Z). Cannot be more than 30 days ago from the current date."
    },
    "sobject": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sobject",
      "examples": [
        "Account",
        "Contact",
        "Opportunity",
        "Lead"
      ],
      "description": "The API name of the sObject type to query for updated records (e.g., Account, Contact, CustomObject__c)."
    }
  }
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "GetSObjectsUpdatedResponse": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "GetSObjectsUpdatedResponse",
      "required": [
        "ids",
        "latestDateCovered"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "ids": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "title": "Ids",
          "description": "An array of record IDs (18-character Salesforce IDs) that were created or modified during the specified time range. Maximum of 600,000 IDs can be returned."
        },
        "latestDateCovered": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Latest Date Covered",
          "description": "The latest date covered by the query in ISO 8601 format. This timestamp guarantees that all updated records before this time have been returned. Use this as the new start parameter in subsequent calls for pagination."
        }
      },
      "description": "Response containing IDs of records that were created or modified during the specified time range."
    }
  },
  "title": "GetSObjectsUpdatedResponseWrapper",
  "required": [
    "data",
    "successful"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Data",
      "required": [
        "ids",
        "latestDateCovered"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "ids": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "title": "Ids",
          "description": "An array of record IDs (18-character Salesforce IDs) that were created or modified during the specified time range. Maximum of 600,000 IDs can be returned."
        },
        "latestDateCovered": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Latest Date Covered",
          "description": "The latest date covered by the query in ISO 8601 format. This timestamp guarantees that all updated records before this time have been returned. Use this as the new start parameter in subsequent calls for pagination."
        }
      },
      "description": "Data from the action execution"
    },
    "error": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Error",
      "description": "Error if any occurred during the execution of the action"
    },
    "successful": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Successful",
      "description": "Whether or not the action execution was successful or not"
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_GET_SUPPORT_KNOWLEDGE_ARTICLES
Retrieves user's visible knowledge articles and data categories from Salesforce Knowledge. Use when you need to access published, draft, or archived articles based on user permissions.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetSupportKnowledgeArticlesRequest",
  "properties": {
    "sort": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sort",
      "examples": [
        "mostViewed"
      ],
      "description": "Sort order for results (e.g., 'mostViewed')."
    },
    "topics": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Topics",
      "examples": [
        "Topic1"
      ],
      "description": "Filter articles by topics."
    },
    "channel": {
      "enum": [
        "App",
        "Pkb",
        "Csp",
        "Prm"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Channel",
      "examples": [
        "App",
        "Pkb"
      ],
      "description": "Specifies the visibility channel through which articles are accessed. Valid values: 'App' (internal app), 'Pkb' (public knowledge base), 'Csp' (customer portal), 'Prm' (partner portal)."
    },
    "page_size": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Page Size",
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        10,
        20,
        50
      ],
      "description": "Number of articles to return per page for pagination."
    },
    "categories": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Categories",
      "examples": [
        "Category1:Subcategory1"
      ],
      "description": "Filters articles by data category groups and categories. Format varies based on category structure."
    },
    "page_number": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Page Number",
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        1,
        2,
        3
      ],
      "description": "Page number for paginated results."
    },
    "publish_status": {
      "enum": [
        "Draft",
        "Online",
        "Archived"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Publish Status",
      "examples": [
        "Online",
        "Draft"
      ],
      "description": "Filter by publication status. Values: 'Draft', 'Online' (published), 'Archived'. Note: Requires 'Manage Articles' permission for 'Online' status. In API version 47.0+ with Lightning Knowledge, all statuses are returned by default."
    },
    "accept_language": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Accept Language",
      "default": "en-US",
      "examples": [
        "en-US",
        "en-US,en;q=0.9",
        "es",
        "fr-FR"
      ],
      "description": "Language for the knowledge articles. Must be specified in HTTP header format (e.g., 'en-US', 'en-US,en;q=0.9'). This field is required by the Salesforce API."
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_GET_UI_API_APPS_USER_NAV_ITEMS
Tool to get personalized navigation items for a specific Salesforce app. Use when you need to retrieve the navigation tabs that a user has access to within an application.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "SalesforceGetUiApiAppsUserNavItemsRequest",
  "required": [
    "app_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "page": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Page",
      "minimum": 0,
      "examples": [
        0,
        1,
        2
      ],
      "description": "Page offset starting position (default: 0). Example: page=2 with pageSize=10 returns items 21-30."
    },
    "app_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "App Id",
      "examples": [
        "06mdN0000068CzKQAU",
        "06mRM000000AFIrYAO"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the Salesforce application for which to retrieve navigation items."
    },
    "page_size": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Page Size",
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        10,
        25,
        50
      ],
      "description": "Maximum number of navigation items per page (default: 25)."
    },
    "form_factor": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Form Factor",
      "examples": [
        "Large",
        "Medium",
        "Small"
      ],
      "description": "Specifies the device form factor for which to retrieve navigation items. Valid values: 'Large' (desktop, default), 'Medium' (tablet), or 'Small' (phone)."
    },
    "nav_item_names": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Nav Item Names",
      "examples": [
        [
          "standard-Account",
          "standard-Contact"
        ],
        [
          "CustomTab1",
          "CustomTab2"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "List of TabDefinition name values to include. If omitted, returns all navigation items for the specified form factor."
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_GET_UI_API_LIST_INFO_RECENT
Tool to get list views for a Salesforce object. Use when you need to retrieve available list views with options to filter by recent usage and search.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "SalesforceGetUIAPIListInfoAccountRecentListsOnlyTrueRequest",
  "properties": {
    "q": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Q",
      "examples": [
        "Recent*",
        "My*",
        "*Accounts"
      ],
      "description": "Search term to filter list view results. Supports wildcards."
    },
    "page_size": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Page Size",
      "maximum": 2000,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        20,
        50,
        100
      ],
      "description": "Number of list view records to return per page. Valid range: 1-2000. Default: 20."
    },
    "page_token": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Page Token",
      "maximum": 2000,
      "minimum": 0,
      "examples": [
        0,
        20,
        40
      ],
      "description": "Page offset for pagination. Maximum offset: 2000. Default: 0."
    },
    "object_api_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Object Api Name",
      "default": "Account",
      "examples": [
        "Account",
        "Contact",
        "Lead",
        "Opportunity"
      ],
      "description": "The API name of the Salesforce object to retrieve list views for. Examples: Account, Contact, Lead, Opportunity, CustomObject__c."
    },
    "recent_lists_only": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Recent Lists Only",
      "default": true,
      "examples": [
        true,
        false
      ],
      "description": "When true, returns only recently used list views. When false, returns all list views for the object."
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_GET_UI_API_RECORD_UI
Tool to retrieve layout, field metadata, and record data in a single response. Use when you need comprehensive information including UI layout configuration, object metadata, and actual record values with child relationships.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetUiApiRecordUiRequest",
  "required": [
    "record_ids"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "modes": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Modes",
      "examples": [
        "View",
        "Edit",
        "Create,Edit,View"
      ],
      "description": "Comma-separated access modes for the record. Valid values: 'Create' (for creating records), 'Edit' (for editing records), 'View' (for displaying records). Determines which fields to get from layout."
    },
    "page_size": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Page Size",
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        5,
        10,
        20
      ],
      "description": "Number of child relationship records per page. Default: 5."
    },
    "record_ids": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Record Ids",
      "examples": [
        "001R0000003I6CoIAK",
        "001dN00000lvXx4QAE,003dN00000lvXxQQAS"
      ],
      "description": "Comma-separated list of up to 200 record IDs. All IDs must be from supported objects."
    },
    "form_factor": {
      "enum": [
        "Large",
        "Medium",
        "Small"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Form Factor",
      "examples": [
        "Large",
        "Medium",
        "Small"
      ],
      "description": "Specifies device form factor. Valid values: 'Large' (desktop), 'Medium' (tablet), 'Small' (mobile phone)."
    },
    "layout_types": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Layout Types",
      "examples": [
        "Compact",
        "Full",
        "Compact,Full"
      ],
      "description": "Comma-separated layout types to return. Valid values: 'Compact' (key fields layout), 'Full' (full layout)."
    },
    "optional_fields": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Optional Fields",
      "examples": [
        "Account.AnnualRevenue,Account.Description",
        "Contact.Email,Contact.Phone"
      ],
      "description": "Comma-separated list of additional field names to include in format ObjectApiName.FieldApiName. If field is accessible to user, it's included in response; otherwise silently omitted without error."
    },
    "child_relationships": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Child Relationships",
      "examples": [
        "Account.Contacts,Account.Opportunities",
        "Opportunity.OpportunityLineItems"
      ],
      "description": "Comma-separated list of child relationships to include in format ObjectApiName.ChildRelationshipName (e.g., 'Account.Contacts,Account.Opportunities'). Child records are paginated with default pageSize of 5."
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_GET_UIAPI_RELATED_LIST_PREFERENCES
Tool to retrieve user preferences for a specific related list on an object. Use when you need to get display settings, column widths, or sort preferences for related lists in Salesforce UI.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetUIAPIRelatedListPreferencesRequest",
  "required": [
    "object_api_name",
    "related_list_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "object_api_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Object Api Name",
      "examples": [
        "Account",
        "Contact",
        "Opportunity",
        "Case"
      ],
      "description": "The API name of the parent object whose related list preferences you want to retrieve."
    },
    "related_list_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Related List Id",
      "examples": [
        "RelatedContactList",
        "Contacts",
        "Opportunities",
        "Cases"
      ],
      "description": "The API name of the related list for which you want to retrieve user preferences."
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_GET_USER_INFO
Retrieves information about the current user or a specific user in Salesforce.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetUserInfoRequest",
  "properties": {
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "default": "",
      "examples": [
        "005XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX",
        "005Wd000001E1BlIAK"
      ],
      "description": "The Salesforce User ID to retrieve information for. If not provided, returns current user info.",
      "human_parameter_name": "User ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The Salesforce User ID of the person you want details for. Leave this blank to get information about your own account."
    },
    "include_permissions": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Include Permissions",
      "default": false,
      "description": "Whether to include user permissions in the response (requires additional API call). Requires elevated access; permission data is returned inside salesforce_user_details and may be partially masked based on the user's profile.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Include Permissions",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose this if you also want profile, role, and permission-related details for the user. It may take slightly longer because it performs an extra lookup."
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_HEAD_ACTIONS_CUSTOM


## SALESFORCE_LIST_ACCOUNTS
Lists accounts from Salesforce using SOQL query, allowing flexible filtering, sorting, and field selection. Results paginate via nextRecordsUrl with up to ~2000 rows per page. REQUEST_LIMIT_EXCEEDED requires exponential backoff; INVALID_FIELD or INSUFFICIENT_ACCESS_OR_READONLY errors indicate profile or field-level restrictions — simplify SELECT/WHERE clauses.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListAccountsRequest",
  "properties": {
    "query": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Query",
      "default": "SELECT Id, Name, Type, Industry, Phone, Website, BillingCity, ShippingCity, AnnualRevenue, NumberOfEmployees FROM Account",
      "examples": [
        "SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Type = 'Customer'",
        "SELECT Id, Name, Industry FROM Account WHERE Industry = 'Technology' ORDER BY Name",
        "SELECT Id, Name, AnnualRevenue FROM Account WHERE AnnualRevenue > 1000000 LIMIT 10"
      ],
      "description": "SOQL query to fetch accounts. Use standard SOQL syntax to filter, sort, and limit results. Always include WHERE and LIMIT clauses to avoid oversized responses. Avoid FIELDS(ALL) without LIMIT. Website and Phone are frequently null; avoid filtering on them without tolerating null values. To include parent-child relationships, explicitly add ParentId or Parent.Name to the SELECT clause.",
      "human_parameter_name": "SOQL Query",
      "human_parameter_description": "The SOQL statement that tells Salesforce which account records and fields to return. Include filters, sorting, and limits to get exactly the accounts you need."
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_LIST_ANALYTICS_TEMPLATES
Tool to list CRM Analytics templates available in the org. Use when you need to discover available templates for creating Analytics apps.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListAnalyticsTemplatesRequest",
  "properties": {
    "page": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Page",
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        1,
        2,
        3
      ],
      "description": "Page number for pagination (1-based indexing). Specifies which page of results to retrieve."
    },
    "type": {
      "enum": [
        "App",
        "Dashboard",
        "Data",
        "Embedded",
        "Lens"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Type",
      "examples": [
        "App",
        "Dashboard",
        "Data"
      ],
      "description": "Filter templates by type. App returns app templates, Dashboard returns dashboard templates, Data returns data templates, Embedded returns embedded templates, Lens returns lens templates."
    },
    "options": {
      "enum": [
        "CreateApp",
        "ManageableOnly",
        "ViewOnly"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Options",
      "examples": [
        "CreateApp",
        "ManageableOnly",
        "ViewOnly"
      ],
      "description": "Filter templates by visibility. CreateApp returns templates that can be used to create apps, ManageableOnly returns templates the user can manage, ViewOnly returns templates the user can only view."
    },
    "pageSize": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Page Size",
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        10,
        25,
        50
      ],
      "description": "Number of results per page. Controls how many template records are returned in a single response."
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_LIST_CAMPAIGNS
Lists campaigns from Salesforce using SOQL query, allowing flexible filtering, sorting, and field selection. Results returned under `response_data.records`; use `Id` (not `Name`) to identify campaigns in downstream operations.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListCampaignsRequest",
  "properties": {
    "query": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Query",
      "default": "SELECT Id, Name, Type, Status, StartDate, EndDate, BudgetedCost, ActualCost, ExpectedRevenue, IsActive, ParentId FROM Campaign",
      "examples": [
        "SELECT Id, Name, Type, Status FROM Campaign WHERE IsActive = true",
        "SELECT Id, Name, StartDate, EndDate FROM Campaign ORDER BY StartDate DESC LIMIT 10",
        "SELECT Id, Name, BudgetedCost FROM Campaign WHERE Type = 'Email' AND Status = 'In Progress'"
      ],
      "description": "SOQL query to fetch campaigns. Use standard SOQL syntax to filter, sort, and limit results. To disambiguate similarly named campaigns, filter on `Type`, `Status`, `StartDate`, or `EndDate`.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Campaign Query",
      "human_parameter_description": "The SOQL statement to choose which campaigns to list and which fields to return. Use it to filter, sort, and limit results to exactly what you need."
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_LIST_CONTACTS
Lists contacts from Salesforce using SOQL query, allowing flexible filtering, sorting, and field selection. Results are returned under `response_data.records`; check `response_data.done` and `response_data.totalSize` for pagination — use OFFSET or `nextRecordsUrl` until `done=true` to retrieve all records.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListContactsRequest",
  "properties": {
    "query": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Query",
      "default": "SELECT Id, FirstName, LastName, Email, Phone, Title, Department, AccountId FROM Contact",
      "examples": [
        "SELECT Id, FirstName, LastName FROM Contact WHERE Email != null",
        "SELECT Id, FirstName, LastName, Email FROM Contact ORDER BY LastName LIMIT 10",
        "SELECT Id, Name, Email FROM Contact WHERE CreatedDate = TODAY"
      ],
      "description": "SOQL query to fetch contacts. Use standard SOQL syntax to filter, sort, and limit results. String literals must be single-quoted. Use correct field API names and relationship traversal (e.g., `Account.Industry`). To filter unassociated contacts use `AccountId = NULL`. Omitting an `AccountId` or `Account.Name` filter returns contacts across all accounts. Nullable fields like `LastActivityDate` require explicit null checks; use `ORDER BY ... NULLS FIRST` for null-safe sorting.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Query",
      "human_parameter_description": "Enter a SOQL query to specify which contacts to retrieve and which fields to return. Use this to filter, sort, or limit results; keep the default if you want a ready-made example."
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_LIST_CUSTOM_INVOCABLE_ACTIONS
Retrieves the list of custom actions including Flow actions, Apex actions, and invocable processes. Use when you need to discover available custom invocable actions in your Salesforce organization.

## SALESFORCE_LIST_EMAIL_TEMPLATES
Lists available email templates in Salesforce with filtering and search capabilities.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListEmailTemplatesRequest",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "default": 50,
      "examples": [
        10,
        25,
        50,
        100,
        200
      ],
      "description": "Maximum number of templates to return.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Limit",
      "human_parameter_description": "Set how many templates to return at once. Use a smaller number for quicker results or a larger number to see more in one go."
    },
    "order_by": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Order By",
      "default": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "Name",
        "Subject",
        "LastModifiedDate",
        "CreatedDate",
        "TemplateType"
      ],
      "description": "Field to sort results by.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Order By",
      "human_parameter_description": "Pick the field to sort the results by, like Name or Last Modified Date. This controls how the templates are ordered."
    },
    "folder_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Folder Name",
      "default": "",
      "examples": [
        "Marketing Templates",
        "Support Templates",
        "Unfiled Public Classic Email Templates"
      ],
      "description": "Filter by folder name to get templates from a specific folder.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Folder Name",
      "human_parameter_description": "Enter the name of the folder that contains the templates you want. Use this to view templates from a specific folder."
    },
    "search_term": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Search Term",
      "default": "",
      "examples": [
        "Welcome",
        "Case",
        "Follow"
      ],
      "description": "Search term to filter templates by name. Uses LIKE operator for partial matches.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Search Term",
      "human_parameter_description": "Type a word or phrase to find templates whose names include it. This helps narrow the list to the templates you care about."
    },
    "include_body": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Include Body",
      "default": false,
      "description": "Whether to include the template body content in results. Note: This may increase response size significantly.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Include Body",
      "human_parameter_description": "Select this to include the full email content in the results. Helpful for previewing or searching within the body, but it may increase load time."
    },
    "template_type": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Template Type",
      "default": "",
      "examples": [
        "text",
        "custom",
        "html",
        "visualforce"
      ],
      "description": "Filter by template type. Common values: text, custom, html, visualforce.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Template Type",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose the kind of template you want to see (for example: text, custom, html, or visualforce). This limits results to that type only."
    },
    "is_active_only": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Is Active Only",
      "default": true,
      "description": "Whether to return only active templates. Set to false to include inactive templates.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Active Only",
      "human_parameter_description": "Keep this on to show only templates that are currently active. Turn it off if you also want to include inactive templates."
    },
    "order_direction": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Order Direction",
      "default": "ASC",
      "examples": [
        "ASC",
        "DESC"
      ],
      "description": "Sort direction: ASC for ascending, DESC for descending.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Order Direction",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose whether to sort ascending (ASC) or descending (DESC). Use this with Order By to get the order you want."
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_LIST_LEADS
Lists leads from Salesforce using SOQL query, allowing flexible filtering, sorting, and field selection. Results are paginated; follow nextRecordsUrl in the response to retrieve subsequent pages — the first page may silently omit matching records beyond the page limit.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListLeadsRequest",
  "properties": {
    "query": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Query",
      "default": "SELECT Id, FirstName, LastName, Company, Title, Email, Phone, Status, LeadSource, Rating, Industry FROM Lead",
      "examples": [
        "SELECT Id, FirstName, LastName, Company FROM Lead WHERE Status = 'New'",
        "SELECT Id, Name, Email, Company FROM Lead ORDER BY CreatedDate DESC LIMIT 10",
        "SELECT Id, Name, Rating FROM Lead WHERE Rating = 'Hot' AND Industry = 'Technology'"
      ],
      "description": "SOQL query to fetch leads. Use standard SOQL syntax to filter, sort, and limit results. Field API names must be exact (e.g., LeadSource, LastModifiedDate) \u2014 invalid names cause MALFORMED_QUERY errors. Date literals like TODAY use the org timezone; use explicit ranges (e.g., LastModifiedDate >= TODAY AND LastModifiedDate < TOMORROW) to avoid boundary misses. Filter null Email with WHERE Email != null when downstream steps require it. Narrow LastModifiedDate ranges to avoid row-limit truncation.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Lead Query",
      "human_parameter_description": "Enter the SOQL statement that defines which leads to retrieve and which fields to return. Use filters, sorting, and limits to narrow the results to exactly what you need."
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_LIST_NOTES
Lists notes from Salesforce using SOQL query, allowing flexible filtering, sorting, and field selection. Designed specifically for Note and ContentNote objects.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListNotesRequest",
  "properties": {
    "query": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Query",
      "default": "SELECT Id, Title, Body, IsPrivate, ParentId, OwnerId, CreatedDate, LastModifiedDate FROM Note",
      "examples": [
        "SELECT Id, Title FROM Note WHERE ParentId = '001XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX'",
        "SELECT Id, Title, Body FROM Note WHERE IsPrivate = false ORDER BY CreatedDate DESC",
        "SELECT Id, Title, ParentId FROM Note WHERE OwnerId = '005XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX' LIMIT 10",
        "SELECT Id, Title FROM Note WHERE CreatedDate = THIS_MONTH",
        "SELECT Id, Title, TextPreview FROM ContentNote WHERE CreatedDate = LAST_WEEK"
      ],
      "description": "SOQL query to fetch notes. Use standard SOQL syntax to filter, sort, and limit results. This action is specifically designed for Note and ContentNote objects. For other objects like EmailMessage (which uses 'Subject' instead of 'Title'), use the general SOQL query action instead. Always include a LIMIT clause to avoid over-fetching; the default query has no LIMIT and may return very large payloads. Omit Body or use TextPreview (ContentNote only) when full note content is not needed.",
      "human_parameter_name": "SOQL Query",
      "human_parameter_description": "Provide a Salesforce SOQL query to select the notes you want to retrieve from Note or ContentNote objects. Use filters (like ParentId, OwnerId, or date) to narrow the results. Note: For querying EmailMessage objects, use the general SOQL query action instead, as EmailMessage uses 'Subject' field instead of 'Title'."
    }
  }
}
```
