## SALESFORCE_SEARCH_CONTACTS
Search Salesforce Contact records (not Leads — use SALESFORCE_SEARCH_LEADS for those) using name, email, phone, account, or title. All parameters support partial/fuzzy matching, so results may include unrelated records; post-filter client-side for exact matches. Partial matches and common names can return multiple contacts — always confirm the correct contact by its 18-character Id before passing to write operations like SALESFORCE_LOG_CALL or SALESFORCE_CREATE_TASK. A response with totalSize=0 is a valid 'not found' outcome. Provide at least one search criterion; omitting all returns a broad, slow result set. Returned Ids are 18-character strings and must be used as-is in downstream tools.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "SearchContactsRequest",
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "John Smith",
        "Jane",
        "Doe"
      ],
      "description": "Search by contact name (first name, last name, or full name). Supports partial matches.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Contact Name",
      "human_parameter_description": "Type the contact's name you want to find. You can use a full name or just part of the first or last name."
    },
    "email": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Email",
      "examples": [
        "john@company.com",
        "@gmail.com",
        "john"
      ],
      "description": "Search by email address. Supports partial matches.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Email Address",
      "human_parameter_description": "Enter the contact's email address or any part of it to find matches."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "default": 50,
      "maximum": 2000,
      "minimum": 1,
      "description": "Maximum number of contacts to return. Maximum allowed is 2000; when totalSize exceeds limit, paginate to retrieve full results.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Limit",
      "human_parameter_description": "Set the maximum number of contacts to return. Lower values are faster; higher values show more results."
    },
    "phone": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Phone",
      "examples": [
        "555-1234",
        "(555)",
        "1234"
      ],
      "description": "Search by phone number. Supports partial matches.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Phone Number",
      "human_parameter_description": "Enter a phone number or part of it to search for contacts. This checks both main and mobile numbers."
    },
    "title": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Title",
      "examples": [
        "Manager",
        "Director",
        "Sales"
      ],
      "description": "Search by job title. Supports partial matches.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Job Title",
      "human_parameter_description": "Enter the contact's job title to filter your search, like Manager or Sales. Partial titles are okay."
    },
    "fields": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Fields",
      "default": "Id,Name,FirstName,LastName,Email,Phone,MobilePhone,Title,AccountId,Account.Name",
      "examples": [
        "Id,Name,Email,Phone",
        "Id,Name,FirstName,LastName,Email,Title,AccountId,Account.Name,CreatedDate"
      ],
      "description": "Comma-separated list of Contact fields to retrieve. Custom and non-default fields are excluded unless explicitly listed here.",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose which contact details to return. Keep the default for common info, or list the fields you need separated by commas."
    },
    "account_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Account Name",
      "examples": [
        "Acme Corp",
        "Tech Solutions"
      ],
      "description": "Search by associated account name. Supports partial matches.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Account Name",
      "human_parameter_description": "Provide the company or account name the contact is associated with to narrow results. Partial names work too."
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_SEARCH_KNOWLEDGE_ARTICLES
Search for Salesforce Knowledge articles with titles matching the search query. Returns auto-suggest results for Knowledge articles based on title matches.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "SearchKnowledgeArticlesRequest",
  "required": [
    "q"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "q": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Q",
      "examples": [
        "race tips",
        "installation guide",
        "troubleshooting",
        "how to"
      ],
      "description": "The user's search query string to match against article titles. This is the text that will be matched against Knowledge article titles."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "maximum": 10,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        5,
        10
      ],
      "description": "Maximum number of suggested articles to return. Default: 5, Maximum: 10. Controls how many article suggestions are included in the response."
    },
    "topics": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Topics",
      "examples": [
        "Installation",
        "Configuration",
        "Troubleshooting"
      ],
      "description": "Knowledge article topic names to filter results. Provide topic names to narrow down the search to articles tagged with specific topics."
    },
    "channel": {
      "enum": [
        "Pkb",
        "Csp",
        "Prm",
        "App"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Channel",
      "examples": [
        "Pkb",
        "Csp",
        "Prm",
        "App"
      ],
      "description": "The channel for which the article is visible. Valid values: 'Pkb' (Public Knowledge Base), 'Csp' (Customer Portal), 'Prm' (Partner Portal), 'App' (Application)."
    },
    "language": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Language",
      "examples": [
        "en_US",
        "fr_FR",
        "de_DE",
        "es_ES"
      ],
      "description": "The article language API name (e.g., 'en_US', 'fr_FR', 'de_DE'). Filters results to articles in the specified language. If not provided, returns articles in all languages."
    },
    "publishStatus": {
      "enum": [
        "Draft",
        "Online",
        "Archived"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Publish Status",
      "examples": [
        "Online",
        "Draft",
        "Archived"
      ],
      "description": "The article publication status. Valid values: 'Draft', 'Online', 'Archived'. Filters results to articles with the specified publication status."
    },
    "validationStatus": {
      "enum": [
        "Draft",
        "Validated",
        "Published"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Validation Status",
      "examples": [
        "Published",
        "Validated",
        "Draft"
      ],
      "description": "The article's validation status. Valid values: 'Draft', 'Validated', 'Published'. Filters results by the article's validation state."
    }
  }
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json

  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "ArticleAttributes": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "ArticleAttributes",
      "required": [
        "type",
        "url"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "url": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Url",
          "description": "REST API URL for accessing this specific article version."
        },
        "type": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Type",
          "description": "Object type, always 'KnowledgeArticleVersion' for article version records."
        }
      },
      "description": "Metadata about the Knowledge article version record."
    },
    "KnowledgeArticleVersion": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "KnowledgeArticleVersion",
      "required": [
        "attributes"
      ],
      "properties": {
```

## SALESFORCE_SEARCH_LEADS
Search for Salesforce leads using criteria like name, email, phone, company, title, status, or lead source. At least one search criterion should be provided — omitting all parameters results in a broad, slow listing of arbitrary records. Partial matches on name, email, and company may return multiple candidates; confirm Email or Company field values before using a lead ID in downstream operations.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "SearchLeadsRequest",
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "John Smith",
        "Jane",
        "Doe"
      ],
      "description": "Search by lead name (first name, last name, or full name). Supports partial matches.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Lead Name",
      "human_parameter_description": "Enter the lead\u2019s name to search for. You can provide a full name or just part of it to broaden the results."
    },
    "email": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Email",
      "examples": [
        "john@company.com",
        "@gmail.com",
        "john"
      ],
      "description": "Search by email address. Supports partial matches.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Email Address",
      "human_parameter_description": "Enter an email address or part of one to find matching leads. You can use a full address or a domain like '@gmail.com'."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "default": 50,
      "maximum": 2000,
      "minimum": 1,
      "description": "Maximum number of leads to return. Maximum cap is 2000; for result sets beyond 2000, use SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY with pagination via nextRecordsUrl.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Result Limit",
      "human_parameter_description": "Set the maximum number of leads to return. Lower values give faster, more focused results."
    },
    "phone": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Phone",
      "examples": [
        "555-1234",
        "(555)",
        "1234"
      ],
      "description": "Search by phone number. Supports partial matches.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Phone Number",
      "human_parameter_description": "Enter a phone number or partial digits to look up leads by phone. Area codes or fragments work too."
    },
    "title": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Title",
      "examples": [
        "Manager",
        "Director",
        "Sales"
      ],
      "description": "Search by job title. Supports partial matches.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Job Title",
      "human_parameter_description": "Enter the job title you want to match, like Manager or Director. Partial titles are accepted."
    },
    "fields": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Fields",
      "default": "Id,Name,FirstName,LastName,Email,Phone,Title,Company,Status,LeadSource,CreatedDate",
      "examples": [
        "Id,Name,Email,Phone,Company,Status",
        "Id,Name,FirstName,LastName,Email,Title,Company,Status,LeadSource,CreatedDate"
      ],
      "description": "Comma-separated list of Lead fields to retrieve.",
      "human_parameter_description": "Specify which lead fields to include in the results. Use a comma-separated list to customize the columns you want back."
    },
    "status": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Status",
      "examples": [
        "Open - Not Contacted",
        "Working - Contacted",
        "Closed - Converted"
      ],
      "description": "Search by lead status.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Lead Status",
      "human_parameter_description": "Select the lead status you want to filter by, such as Open or Working. Use this to narrow results to a specific stage."
    },
    "company": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Company",
      "examples": [
        "Acme Corp",
        "Tech Solutions"
      ],
      "description": "Search by company name. Supports partial matches.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Company Name",
      "human_parameter_description": "Enter the company name the lead works for. Partial names are fine if you\u2019re not sure of the exact spelling."
    },
    "lead_source": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Lead Source",
      "examples": [
        "Web",
        "Phone Inquiry",
        "Partner Referral"
      ],
      "description": "Search by lead source.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Lead Source",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose how the lead was acquired, like Web or Phone Inquiry. This helps filter leads by their origin."
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_SEARCH_NOTES
Search for Salesforce notes using multiple criteria like title, body content, parent record, owner, or creation date. Provide at least one filter criterion — omitting all filters returns a broad, slow, noisy listing.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "SearchNotesRequest",
  "properties": {
    "body": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Body",
      "examples": [
        "discussed pricing",
        "action items",
        "next steps"
      ],
      "description": "Search within note body content using full-text search (SOSL). When provided, body search is combined with any additional filters using AND logic.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Note Body",
      "human_parameter_description": "Provide words or phrases that appear in the note\u2019s content to find relevant notes. Use a few keywords you remember."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "default": 50,
      "maximum": 2000,
      "minimum": 1,
      "description": "Maximum number of notes to return. Maximum allowed value is 2000; apply precise filters or paginate when result sets may exceed the limit.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Limit",
      "human_parameter_description": "Set how many notes to return at most. Lower this for faster searches; increase it to see more results (up to 2000)."
    },
    "title": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Title",
      "examples": [
        "Meeting Notes",
        "Follow up",
        "Important"
      ],
      "description": "Search by note title. Supports partial matches.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Note Title",
      "human_parameter_description": "Enter words from the note\u2019s title to find matching notes. Partial titles work\u2014type what you remember."
    },
    "fields": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Fields",
      "default": "Id,Title,Body,ParentId,Parent.Name,OwnerId,Owner.Name,IsPrivate,CreatedDate,LastModifiedDate",
      "examples": [
        "Id,Title,Body,ParentId,Parent.Name,CreatedDate",
        "Id,Title,Body,ParentId,Parent.Name,OwnerId,Owner.Name,IsPrivate"
      ],
      "description": "Comma-separated list of Note fields to retrieve. Parent.Name may be null when the parent record is deleted or inaccessible.",
      "human_parameter_description": "Specify which details you want returned for each note (e.g., title, owner). Leave the default unless you need specific fields."
    },
    "is_private": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Is Private",
      "description": "Filter by private status. True for private notes, False for public notes. Private notes may be silently omitted if the integration user lacks permission \u2014 absence of results does not guarantee no notes exist.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Is Private",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose whether to show only private notes, only public notes, or leave blank to include both."
    },
    "owner_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Owner Name",
      "examples": [
        "John Smith",
        "Jane"
      ],
      "description": "Search by note owner's user name. Supports partial matches.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Owner Name",
      "human_parameter_description": "Enter the name of the person who owns the note to narrow results. Partial names are okay."
    },
    "parent_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Parent Name",
      "examples": [
        "Acme Corp",
        "John Smith"
      ],
      "description": "Search by parent record name (Account, Contact, Lead, Opportunity, Case, or custom objects). Supports partial matches. Searches across common parent object types to find matching records. Cannot filter by parent record ID or parent object type; use SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY for ID-scoped note lookups.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Parent Name",
      "human_parameter_description": "Type the name of the related record (like an Account or Contact) the note is attached to. Partial names are fine."
    },
    "created_date_to": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Created Date To",
      "examples": [
        "2024-12-31"
      ],
      "description": "Filter notes created on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).",
      "human_parameter_name": "Created To",
      "human_parameter_description": "End date for when the notes were created, in YYYY-MM-DD. Use this to include only older notes up to this date."
    },
    "created_date_from": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Created Date From",
      "examples": [
        "2024-01-01"
      ],
      "description": "Filter notes created on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).",
      "human_parameter_name": "Created From",
      "human_parameter_description": "Start date for when the notes were created, in YYYY-MM-DD. Use this to include only newer notes."
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_SEARCH_OPPORTUNITIES
Search for Salesforce opportunities using multiple criteria like name, account, stage, amount, close date, or status. Apply at least one filter to avoid broad result sets. Partial-match searches may return multiple similar records; verify the correct record by Id before downstream use.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "SearchOpportunitiesRequest",
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "Q4 Deal",
        "Enterprise Sale",
        "Renewal"
      ],
      "description": "Search by opportunity name. Supports partial matches.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Opportunity Name",
      "human_parameter_description": "Type part of the opportunity\u2019s name to find matching records. Use this if you know the deal\u2019s title or a keyword."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "default": 50,
      "maximum": 2000,
      "minimum": 1,
      "description": "Maximum number of opportunities to return. Maximum value is 2000. When totalSize in the response exceeds limit, use nextRecordsUrl to paginate through the full dataset.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Limit",
      "human_parameter_description": "Set how many results to return. Use a smaller number for quick previews or a higher number to see more deals."
    },
    "fields": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Fields",
      "default": "Id,Name,AccountId,Account.Name,StageName,Amount,CloseDate,IsClosed,IsWon,Probability,LeadSource,CreatedDate",
      "examples": [
        "Id,Name,AccountId,Account.Name,StageName,Amount,CloseDate",
        "Id,Name,AccountId,Account.Name,StageName,Amount,CloseDate,IsClosed,IsWon,Probability"
      ],
      "description": "Comma-separated list of Opportunity fields to retrieve. Supports direct Opportunity fields (e.g., Id, Name, Amount) and parent relationship fields (e.g., Account.Name, Owner.Name). Note: Contact.* fields (Contact.Name, Contact.Email, etc.) are NOT valid because Opportunity does not have a direct parent relationship to Contact; use OpportunityContactRole queries to get contact information. Parent relationship fields like Account.Name may be null on returned records; guard against missing nested values when post-processing.",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose which opportunity details to return, separated by commas. If you're not sure, the default includes the most common fields. Note: Contact.* fields are not supported as Opportunity has no direct Contact relationship."
    },
    "is_won": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Is Won",
      "description": "Filter by won status. True for won opportunities, False for lost (only applies to closed opportunities).",
      "human_parameter_name": "Is Won",
      "human_parameter_description": "Show only won deals (true) or lost ones (false). Leave blank to include both; this applies to closed opportunities."
    },
    "is_closed": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Is Closed",
      "description": "Filter by closed status. True for closed opportunities, False for open.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Is Closed",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose whether to see closed deals (true) or open ones (false). Leave blank to include both."
    },
    "amount_max": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Amount Max",
      "examples": [
        100000,
        1000000
      ],
      "description": "Maximum opportunity amount.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Maximum Amount",
      "human_parameter_description": "Set the largest deal amount to include. Use this to cap results at a certain size."
    },
    "amount_min": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Amount Min",
      "examples": [
        1000,
        50000
      ],
      "description": "Minimum opportunity amount.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Minimum Amount",
      "human_parameter_description": "Set the smallest deal amount to include. Use this to filter out smaller opportunities."
    },
    "stage_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Stage Name",
      "examples": [
        "Prospecting",
        "Qualification",
        "Proposal/Price Quote",
        "Closed Won"
      ],
      "description": "Search by opportunity stage.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Stage Name",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose the sales stage to filter by, like Prospecting or Closed Won. This narrows results to opportunities at that step."
    },
    "lead_source": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Lead Source",
      "examples": [
        "Web",
        "Phone Inquiry",
        "Partner Referral"
      ],
      "description": "Search by lead source.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Lead Source",
      "human_parameter_description": "Filter by where the opportunity came from, like Web or Partner Referral. Enter a specific source to narrow results."
    },
    "account_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Account Name",
      "examples": [
        "Acme Corp",
        "Tech Solutions"
      ],
      "description": "Search by associated account name. Supports partial matches.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Account Name",
      "human_parameter_description": "Enter part or all of the customer account\u2019s name linked to the opportunity. Helpful when you\u2019re looking for deals under a specific company."
    },
    "close_date_to": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Close Date To",
      "examples": [
        "2024-12-31",
        "2025-06-30",
        "2025-09-30"
      ],
      "description": "Search opportunities with close date before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).",
      "human_parameter_name": "Close Date To",
      "human_parameter_description": "Show opportunities closing on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Helpful for limiting results to a specific timeframe."
    },
    "close_date_from": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Close Date From",
      "examples": [
        "2024-01-01",
        "2024-06-15",
        "2025-03-31"
      ],
      "description": "Search opportunities with close date from this date (YYYY-MM-DD). When computing relative ranges (e.g., 'this week'), derive dates using the user's local timezone to avoid off-by-one-day errors.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Close Date From",
      "human_parameter_description": "Show opportunities closing on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Use this to focus on upcoming or current period deals."
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_SEARCH_TASKS
Search for Salesforce tasks using multiple criteria like subject, status, priority, assigned user, related records, or dates. Always provide at least one filter criterion — no filters produces broad, slow results. For complex filtering not supported here, use SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "SearchTasksRequest",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "default": 50,
      "maximum": 2000,
      "minimum": 1,
      "description": "Maximum number of tasks to return. Maximum is 2000. When returned record count equals limit or nextRecordsUrl is present in the response, paginate to retrieve all matching tasks.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Task Limit",
      "human_parameter_description": "The maximum number of tasks to return. Increase for more results or decrease for a shorter, faster list."
    },
    "fields": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Fields",
      "default": "Id,Subject,Status,Priority,ActivityDate,IsClosed,Description,OwnerId,Owner.Name,WhatId,What.Name,WhoId,Who.Name",
      "examples": [
        "Id,Subject,Status,Priority,ActivityDate,IsClosed",
        "Id,Subject,Status,Priority,ActivityDate,IsClosed,OwnerId,Owner.Name,WhatId,What.Name"
      ],
      "description": "Comma-separated list of Task fields to retrieve. WhoId/Who.Name, WhatId/What.Name, OwnerId/Owner.Name, and Description can be null on Task records \u2014 guard against null before accessing nested .Name fields. Call-specific fields (CallType, CallDurationInSeconds) are frequently null and unreliable as sole filters.",
      "human_parameter_description": "A comma-separated list of task fields to return. Keep the default unless you need specific columns."
    },
    "status": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Status",
      "examples": [
        "Not Started",
        "In Progress",
        "Completed",
        "Waiting on someone else"
      ],
      "description": "Search by task status.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Task Status",
      "human_parameter_description": "The task status to filter by, like Not Started or Completed. Use this to see tasks at a specific stage."
    },
    "subject": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Subject",
      "examples": [
        "Follow up",
        "Call",
        "Meeting"
      ],
      "description": "Search by task subject. Supports partial matches. Many Tasks are system-generated or email-related; combine with activity_date_from/activity_date_to, status, and priority for better precision.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Task Subject",
      "human_parameter_description": "Words from the task\u2019s subject you want to search for. Enter part of the title to find matching tasks."
    },
    "priority": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Priority",
      "examples": [
        "High",
        "Normal",
        "Low"
      ],
      "description": "Search by task priority.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Task Priority",
      "human_parameter_description": "The priority level to filter by (High, Normal, or Low). Use this to focus on more important tasks."
    },
    "is_closed": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Is Closed",
      "description": "Filter by closed status. True for completed tasks, False for open tasks.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Closed Status",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose whether to show completed tasks (true) or open tasks (false). Leave blank to include both."
    },
    "account_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Account Name",
      "examples": [
        "Acme Corp",
        "Tech Solutions"
      ],
      "description": "Search by related account name. Supports partial matches.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Related Account",
      "human_parameter_description": "The account linked to the task you\u2019re looking for. Type the account\u2019s name or part of it."
    },
    "contact_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Contact Name",
      "examples": [
        "John Smith",
        "Jane Doe"
      ],
      "description": "Search by related contact name. Supports partial matches.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Related Contact",
      "human_parameter_description": "The contact associated with the task. Enter the person\u2019s name or part of it to match."
    },
    "activity_date_to": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Activity Date To",
      "examples": [
        "2024-12-31"
      ],
      "description": "Search tasks with activity date before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).",
      "human_parameter_name": "Activity Date To",
      "human_parameter_description": "The latest due date to include (YYYY-MM-DD). Use this to show tasks due on or before this date."
    },
    "assigned_to_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Assigned To Name",
      "examples": [
        "John Smith",
        "Jane"
      ],
      "description": "Search by assigned user name. Supports partial matches.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Assigned User",
      "human_parameter_description": "The name of the person the task is assigned to. Enter a full or partial name to find their tasks."
    },
    "activity_date_from": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Activity Date From",
      "examples": [
        "2024-01-01"
      ],
      "description": "Search tasks with activity date from this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Date filtering may not strictly bound results; verify ActivityDate in returned records when date accuracy matters.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Activity Date From",
      "human_parameter_description": "The earliest due date to include (YYYY-MM-DD). Use this to show tasks due on or after this date."
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_SEND_EMAIL
Sends an email through Salesforce with options for recipients, attachments, and activity logging. Can partially succeed — check per-recipient success/failure status rather than treating the call as all-or-nothing. For large recipient lists, use SALESFORCE_SEND_MASS_EMAIL instead.

## SALESFORCE_SEND_EMAIL_FROM_TEMPLATE
Sends an email using a predefined Salesforce email template with merge field support.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "SendEmailFromTemplateRequest",
  "required": [
    "template_id",
    "recipient_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "log_email": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Log Email",
      "default": true,
      "description": "Whether to log the email on the recipient's activity timeline. Defaults to true for template emails.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Log Email",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose whether to save this email to the recipient\u2019s activity history. Turn this off if you don\u2019t want it recorded."
    },
    "sender_type": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sender Type",
      "default": "CurrentUser",
      "examples": [
        "CurrentUser",
        "OrgWideEmailAddress"

      "description": "Type of sender. Valid values: CurrentUser, DefaultWorkflowUser, OrgWideEmailAddress.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Sender Type",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose who the email should appear to be from\u2014your user, the default workflow user, or an organization-wide email address."
    },
    "template_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Template Id",
      "examples": [
        "00XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXM",
        "00XWd000000q8qPMAQ"
      ],
      "description": "ID of the email template to use.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Template ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose the email template you want to send. This selects the content and merge fields used in the message."
    },
    "cc_addresses": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          }
        }
      ],
      "title": "Cc Addresses",
      "examples": [
        "supervisor@company.com",
        [
          "legal@company.com",
          "compliance@company.com"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "CC email addresses. Can be a comma-delimited string or a list.",
      "human_parameter_name": "CC Addresses",
      "human_parameter_description": "People you want to copy on the email. They\u2019ll receive the message and can see other CC\u2019d recipients."
    },
    "recipient_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Recipient Id",
      "examples": [
        "003XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX",
        "00QXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"
      ],
      "description": "ID of the lead, contact, or person account to send the email to. Required when using templates.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Recipient ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "Select the person you\u2019re emailing by providing their record ID. Use a Lead, Contact, or Person Account ID for the recipient."
    },
    "bcc_addresses": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          }
        }
      ],
      "title": "Bcc Addresses",
      "examples": [
        "archive@company.com"
      ],
      "description": "BCC email addresses. Can be a comma-delimited string or a list.",
      "human_parameter_name": "BCC Addresses",
      "human_parameter_description": "People you want to blind-copy on the email. Other recipients won\u2019t see these addresses."
    },
    "attachment_ids": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          }
        }
      ],
      "title": "Attachment Ids",
      "examples": [
        "069XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX",
        [
          "069XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX",
          "069YYYYYYYYYYYYYYY"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "IDs of files to attach. Can be a comma-delimited string or a list.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Attachment IDs",
      "human_parameter_description": "Attach files by providing their file IDs. You can include one or multiple attachments."
    },
    "sender_address": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sender Address",
      "default": "",
      "examples": [
        "noreply@company.com",
        "support@company.com"
      ],
      "description": "Organization-wide email address. Required only when sender_type is OrgWideEmailAddress.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Sender Address",
      "human_parameter_description": "If you selected an organization-wide sender, enter that email address here. Leave blank if using your own user."
    },
    "related_record_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Related Record Id",
      "default": "",
      "examples": [
        "500XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX",
        "006XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX",
        "001XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"
      ],
      "description": "ID of a related record (e.g., Case, Opportunity) to populate merge fields from a different object.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Related Record ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "Optionally link a related record (like a Case or Opportunity) so the template can pull in the right details. Use this if your template references another object."
    },
    "add_threading_tokens": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Add Threading Tokens",
      "default": false,
      "description": "Whether to add threading tokens for email-to-case or custom threading. Useful for case-related emails.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Add Threading Tokens",
      "human_parameter_description": "Add special tokens to help keep replies tied to the right case or conversation thread. Use this when emailing about a case."
    },
    "additional_to_addresses": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          }
        }
      ],
      "title": "Additional To Addresses",
      "examples": [
        "manager@company.com",
        [
          "team@company.com",
          "support@company.com"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Additional email addresses to send to (besides the recipient). Can be a comma-delimited string or a list.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Additional To Addresses",
      "human_parameter_description": "Add extra primary recipients to the email in addition to the main recipient. Enter one address or multiple."
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_SEND_MASS_EMAIL
Sends bulk emails to multiple recipients immediately and irreversibly using a template or custom content. Requires either a valid template_id or both subject and body; omitting all three causes errors. Processes in batches for performance. Check failedRecipients and summary.failureCount in the response even when success=true, as individual recipient failures can occur without an overall failure.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "SendMassEmailRequest",
  "required": [
    "recipient_ids"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "body": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Body",
      "default": "",
      "examples": [
        "Dear Customer,\n\nWe have exciting news to share...",
        "<html><body><h1>Welcome!</h1><p>Thank you for joining us.</p></body></html>"
      ],
      "description": "Body content of the email. Required if template_id is not provided.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Email Body",
      "human_parameter_description": "The main message you want to send. Enter plain text or HTML if you\u2019re not using a template."
    },
    "is_html": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Is Html",
      "default": false,
      "description": "Whether the email body is HTML formatted. Only applies when not using a template.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Is HTML",
      "human_parameter_description": "Turn this on if your message includes HTML (headings, links, formatting). Use only when you\u2019re providing a custom body."
    },
    "subject": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Subject",
      "default": "",
      "examples": [
        "Important Update for Our Valued Customers",
        "New Product Launch Announcement",
        "Monthly Newsletter - August 2025"
      ],
      "description": "Subject line of the email. Required if template_id is not provided.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Email Subject",
      "human_parameter_description": "What you want the email subject to be. Fill this in if you\u2019re not using a template."
    },
    "batch_size": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Batch Size",
      "default": 50,
      "examples": [
        25,
        50,
        100,
        150
      ],
      "description": "Number of recipients to process in each batch. Maximum is 150.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Batch Size",
      "human_parameter_description": "How many recipients to send at once. Larger batches finish faster, but each batch will be capped at 150."
    },
    "log_emails": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Log Emails",
      "default": true,
      "description": "Whether to log the emails on each recipient's activity timeline.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Log Emails",
      "human_parameter_description": "Keep a record of these emails on each recipient\u2019s activity timeline in Salesforce. Turn this off if you don\u2019t want them logged."
    },
    "sender_type": {
      "enum": [
        "CurrentUser",
        "DefaultWorkflowUser",
        "OrgWideEmailAddress"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sender Type",
      "default": "CurrentUser",
      "examples": [
        "CurrentUser",
        "OrgWideEmailAddress"
      ],
      "description": "Type of sender.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Sender Type",
      "human_parameter_description": "Who the email should appear to come from. Choose your own user, the default workflow user, or an org-wide email address."
    },
    "template_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Template Id",
      "default": "",
      "examples": [
        "00XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXM",
        "00XWd000000q8qPMAQ"
      ],
      "description": "ID of the email template to use. If not specified, subject and body must be provided.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Template ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose a Salesforce email template to send the same message to everyone. Leave this blank if you\u2019ll write a custom subject and body below."
    },
    "recipient_ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Recipient Ids",
      "examples": [
        [
          "003XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX",
          "003YYYYYYYYYYYYYYY"
        ],
        [
          "00QXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX",
          "00QYYYYYYYYYYYYYYY",
          "003ZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZ"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "List of IDs for leads, contacts, or person accounts to send emails to. Maximum 150 recipients per call. All recipient records must have a non-null Email field; null emails generate per-recipient errors.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Recipient IDs",
      "human_parameter_description": "The people you want to email. Paste the Salesforce IDs for the leads, contacts, or person accounts you\u2019re targeting; you can include up to 150 at a time."
    },
    "sender_address": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sender Address",
      "default": "",
      "examples": [
        "marketing@company.com",
        "newsletter@company.com"
      ],
      "description": "Organization-wide email address. Required only when sender_type is OrgWideEmailAddress.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Sender Address",
      "human_parameter_description": "The specific org-wide email address to send from (for example, marketing@yourcompany.com). Only needed if you selected OrgWideEmailAddress as the sender."
    }
  }
}
```

```json
                      "description": "The status code indicating the type of error that occurred (e.g., INVALID_EMAIL_ADDRESS, REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING, UNVERIFIED_SENDER_ADDRESS, UNKNOWN_EXCEPTION)."
                    },
                    "targetObjectId": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "title": "Target Object Id",
                      "description": "The ID of the target object (Contact, Lead, or User) related to the error, if applicable."
                    }
                  },
                  "description": "Error information when an email send operation fails."
                },
                "title": "Errors",
                "description": "Array of SendEmailError objects containing detailed error information when the email send operation fails. Null or empty array when success is true."
              },
              "success": {
                "type": "boolean",
                "title": "Success",
                "description": "Indicates whether the email was successfully accepted by Salesforce for delivery. Note: true means Salesforce accepted the request to send the email, but does not guarantee actual delivery as email sending is handled asynchronously."
              }
            },
            "description": "Result of a single email send operation."
          },
          "title": "Results",
          "description": "Array of SendEmailResult objects, one for each recipient email send operation."
```
```json
        }
      },
      "description": "Data from the action execution"
    },
    "error": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Error",
      "description": "Error if any occurred during the execution of the action"
    },
    "successful": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Successful",
      "description": "Whether or not the action execution was successful or not"
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_TOOLING_QUERY
Tool to execute SOQL queries against Salesforce Tooling API metadata objects. Use when you need to query metadata components like ApexClass, ApexTrigger, ValidationRule, WorkflowRule, FieldDefinition, or EntityDefinition. The Tooling API exposes objects that use the external object framework and provides granular access to metadata components for development and deployment tasks.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ToolingQueryRequest",
  "required": [
    "query"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "query": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Query",
      "examples": [
        "SELECT Id, Name FROM ApexClass LIMIT 10",
        "SELECT Id, Name, CreatedDate FROM ApexTrigger WHERE Status = 'Active'",
        "SELECT Id, DeveloperName, EntityDefinition.QualifiedApiName FROM FieldDefinition WHERE EntityDefinition.QualifiedApiName = 'Account'",
        "SELECT Id, TableEnumOrId, ValidationName, Active FROM ValidationRule WHERE EntityDefinition.QualifiedApiName = 'Opportunity'"
      ],
      "minLength": 5,
      "description": "The SOQL query to execute against Tooling API metadata objects. Example: 'SELECT Id, Name FROM ApexClass LIMIT 10'. Can query metadata objects like ApexClass, ApexTrigger, ValidationRule, WorkflowRule, FieldDefinition, EntityDefinition, etc. Supports standard SOQL syntax including WHERE, ORDER BY, LIMIT, and OFFSET clauses. Maximum OFFSET value is 2000 when using pagination with LIMIT/OFFSET.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Tooling Query",
      "human_parameter_description": "Enter the SOQL query to execute against Salesforce metadata objects using the Tooling API. Query objects like ApexClass, ApexTrigger, ValidationRule, FieldDefinition, etc."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for tooling API query"
}
```

## SALESFORCE_UPDATE_FAVORITE
Tool to update a favorite's properties in Salesforce UI API. Use when you need to reorder favorites or modify their display properties.

**Input schema:**
```json
{

        "Important Account List"

        "0MV8c000000TN8jGAG"
      ],
      "description": "The unique 15 or 18-character Salesforce ID of the favorite to update."

  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_UPDATE_LIST_VIEW_PREFERENCES
Tool to update user preferences for a Salesforce list view including column widths, text wrapping, and display order. Use when you need to customize how columns appear in a list view.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateListViewPreferencesRequest",
  "required": [
    "object_api_name",
    "list_view_api_name"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "column_wrap": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Column Wrap",
      "examples": [
        {
          "Name": true,
          "Type": false,
          "BillingState": false
        },
        {
          "Title": false,
          "Description": true
        }
      ],
      "description": "Maps field API names to boolean values indicating whether text should wrap to multiple lines (true) or be truncated (false).",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "boolean"
      }
    },
    "column_order": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Column Order",
      "examples": [
        [
          "Name",
          "Type",
          "BillingState",
          "Industry"
        ],
        [
          "Industry",
          "AnnualRevenue",
          "Phone",
          "Name"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Defines the left-to-right display order of columns using field API names."
    },
    "column_widths": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Column Widths",
      "examples": [
        {
          "Name": 250,
          "Type": 150,
          "BillingState": 120
        },
        {
          "Phone": 150,
          "Industry": 200,
          "AnnualRevenue": 200
        }
      ],
      "description": "Maps field API names to their desired display widths in pixels. Only include columns you want to resize.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "integer"
      }
    },
    "object_api_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Object Api Name",
      "examples": [
        "Account",
        "Lead",
        "Contact",
        "Opportunity"
      ],
      "description": "The API name of the Salesforce object (e.g., 'Account', 'Lead', 'Contact')."
    },
    "list_view_api_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "List View Api Name",
      "examples": [
        "AllAccounts",
        "MyLeads",
        "RecentlyViewedContacts"
      ],
      "description": "The API name of the specific list view (e.g., 'AllAccounts', 'MyLeads')."
    }
  }
}
```

```json
      "examples": [
        75
      ],
      "description": "Estimated confidence percentage (0-100) in closing. Usually implied by StageName, but can be overridden. Round decimal probabilities to whole numbers.",
      "human_parameter_description": "How likely you think the deal will close, from 0 to 100%. This often follows the selected stage."
    },
    "Pricebook2Id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Pricebook2 Id",
      "examples": [
        "01sP0000000aXUZIA2"
      ],
      "description": "ID of the associated Pricebook2. Required to add line items if products are enabled. Cannot update if line items exist.",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose the price book for this opportunity by providing its Salesforce ID. Required if you plan to add products."
    },
    "FiscalQuarter": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Fiscal Quarter",
      "examples": [
        1,
        2,
        3,
        4
      ],
      "description": "Fiscal quarter (1-4) of the CloseDate, based on organization's fiscal year settings.",
      "human_parameter_description": "The fiscal quarter for the close date (1\u20134). Provide only if you need to set or correct fiscal info."

    "custom_fields": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Custom Fields",
      "examples": [
        {
          "DeliveryInstallationStatus__c": "In Progress"
        },
        {
          "External_Opportunity_ID__c": "OPP-5566"
        }
      ],
      "description": "Dictionary of custom field API names and their values. Custom field names typically end with '__c'.",
      "additionalProperties": true,
      "human_parameter_description": "Provide any custom Opportunity fields to update. Use the API field name (ending in '__c') as the key."
    },
    "HasOverdueTask": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Has Overdue Task",
      "description": "Read-only. True if opportunity has an overdue task (API v35.0+).",
      "human_parameter_description": "Shows whether any tasks are overdue for this opportunity. Managed by Salesforce."
    },
    "LastViewedDate": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Last Viewed Date",
      "format": "date-time",
      "description": "Read-only. Timestamp current user last viewed this record (ISO 8601 UTC). Null if only referenced (LastReferencedDate).",
      "human_parameter_description": "When you last viewed this record. Set by Salesforce; you don\u2019t need to provide this."
    },
    "OrderNumber__c": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Order Number  C",
      "examples": [

      ],
      "description": "Order number associated with the opportunity.",
      "human_parameter_description": "Provide the related sales order number for this deal, if you have one."
    },
    "SystemModstamp": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "System Modstamp",

      "description": "Read-only. Last system modification timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC), by user or automation.",
      "human_parameter_description": "System-generated timestamp of the last change, including automation. Set by Salesforce."
    },
    "ExpectedRevenue": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Expected Revenue",
      "description": "Read-only. Calculated as Amount * Probability. Updated by changes to Amount or Probability.",

    "HasOpenActivity": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Has Open Activity",

    },
    "attributes__url": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Attributes  Url",

    },
    "ForecastCategory": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Forecast Category",
      "examples": [
        "Pipeline",
        "Best Case",
        "Commit",
        "Omitted",

      ],
      "description": "Forecast category (e.g., 'Pipeline', 'BestCase'). Implied by StageName but can be overridden. In API v12.0+, value is set via ForecastCategoryName.",
      "human_parameter_description": "Set the forecast category for this deal if you want to override what the stage would set."
    },
    "LastActivityDate": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Last Activity Date",
      "format": "date",
      "description": "Read-only. Due date of most recent event or last closed task (YYYY-MM-DD).",
      "human_parameter_description": "The date of the most recent activity on this record. Managed by Salesforce based on tasks and events."
    },
    "LastModifiedById": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Last Modified By Id",
      "description": "Read-only. ID of the user who last modified this record.",
      "human_parameter_description": "The Salesforce User ID of the person who last changed the record. Set by Salesforce."
    },
    "LastModifiedDate": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Last Modified Date",

      "description": "Read-only. Last modification timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC).",
      "human_parameter_description": "The most recent time the record was updated. Set by Salesforce; you don\u2019t need to provide this."
    },
    "attributes__type": {

      "title": "Attributes  Type",
```

## SALESFORCE_UPDATE_RECORD
Tool to update a record's data in Salesforce via UI API. Use when you need to modify field values on an existing record. Salesforce validation rules are enforced. Pass If-Unmodified-Since header to prevent conflicts.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateRecordRequest",
  "required": [
    "record_id",
    "fields"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "fields": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Fields",
      "examples": [
        {
          "Name": "Updated via UI API Test"
        },
        {
          "Email": "john.smith@example.com",
          "LastName": "Smith",
          "FirstName": "John"
        }
      ],
      "description": "Map of field API names to their new values. Only include fields you want to update. Field names should use API names (e.g., 'FirstName', 'Email', 'CustomField__c'). Unspecified fields remain unchanged.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "anyOf": [
          {
            "type": "string"
          },
          {
            "type": "integer"
          },
          {
            "type": "number"
          },
          {
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          {
            "type": "null"
          }
        ]
      }
    },
    "api_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Api Name",
      "examples": [
        "Contact",
        "Account",
        "Lead"
      ],
      "description": "The API name of the record's object type (e.g., 'Contact', 'Account', 'Lead'). Can be null or omitted for updates."
    },
    "record_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Record Id",
      "examples": [
        "001dN00000lvXx4QAE",
        "003XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"
      ],
      "description": "The unique 15 or 18-character Salesforce ID of the record to update."
    },
    "use_default_rule": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Use Default Rule",
      "examples": [
        false,
        true
      ],
      "description": "Case, Lead, and Account objects only. If true, applies assignment and auto-response rules. Default is false."
    },
    "trigger_user_email": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Trigger User Email",
      "examples": [
        false,
        true
      ],
      "description": "Case and Lead objects only. If true, sends email notifications to users in the organization. Default is false."
    },
    "if_unmodified_since": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "If Unmodified Since",
      "examples": [
        "Wed, 21 Oct 2025 07:28:00 GMT"
      ],
      "description": "RFC 7231 date/time format. Makes the request conditional - server will only update if the record hasn't been modified since this timestamp. Returns 412 Precondition Failed if the record was modified after this date."
    },
    "trigger_other_email": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Trigger Other Email",
      "examples": [
        false,
        true
      ],
      "description": "Case object only. If true, sends email notifications outside the organization. Default is false."
    },
    "allow_save_on_duplicate": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Allow Save On Duplicate",
      "examples": [
        false,
        true
      ],
      "description": "If true, allows the record to be saved even if duplicate detection rules are triggered. Default is false."
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_UPDATE_RELATED_LIST_PREFERENCES
Tool to update user preferences for a specific related list on an object in Salesforce. Use when customizing display settings such as column widths, text wrapping, column ordering, and sorting preferences for related lists.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateRelatedListPreferencesRequest",
  "required": [
    "composite_layout_name"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "ordered_by": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "OrderByInfo",
        "required": [
          "fieldApiName",
          "isAscending"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "isAscending": {
            "type": "boolean",
            "title": "Is Ascending",
            "examples": [
              true,
              false
            ],
            "description": "Whether the sort order is ascending (true) or descending (false)."
          },
          "fieldApiName": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Field Api Name",
            "examples": [
              "Name",
              "CreatedDate",
              "Email"
            ],
            "description": "The API name of the field to sort by."
          }
        },
        "description": "Sort preference for a column."
      },
      "title": "Ordered By",
      "examples": [
        [
          {
            "isAscending": true,
            "fieldApiName": "Name"
          }
        ],
        [
          {
            "isAscending": false,
            "fieldApiName": "CreatedDate"
          },
          {
            "isAscending": true,
            "fieldApiName": "Name"
          }
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Array of sort preference objects defining field sorting order. Each object specifies a field and sort direction."
    },
    "column_wrap": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Column Wrap",
      "examples": [
        {
          "Name": true,
          "Email": false,
          "Phone": false
        },
        {
          "Industry": true,
          "AnnualRevenue": false
        }
      ],
```

## SALESFORCE_UPLOAD_FILE
Upload a file to Salesforce Files home via the Connect REST API. Use when you need to attach files to records or store them in a user's personal library. File size limit: 50 MB per request.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UploadFileRequest",
  "properties": {
    "desc": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Desc",
      "examples": [
        "Quarterly sales analysis for review",
        "Signed contract from Acme Corp",
        "Notes from customer meeting on 2024-01-15"
      ],
      "description": "Description of the file to help users understand its content."
    },
    "file": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "FileUploadable",
      "required": [
        "name",
        "mimetype",
        "s3key"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "name": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Name",
          "examples": [
            "document.pdf",
            "image.jpg",
            "report.docx"
          ],
          "description": "The filename that will be used when uploading the file to the destination service"
        },
        "s3key": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "S3Key",
          "examples": [
            "47563/gmail/GET_ATTACHMENT/response/12345"
          ],
          "description": "The S3 key of a publicly accessible file, typically returned from a previous download action that stored the file in S3. This key references an existing file that can be uploaded to another service."
        },
        "mimetype": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Mimetype",
          "examples": [
            "application/pdf",
            "image/jpeg",
            "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document"
          ],
          "description": "The MIME type of the file"
        }
      },
      "description": "File to upload to Salesforce Files home. Either 'file' or 'filename' + 'content_b64' must be provided.",
      "file_uploadable": true,
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "title": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Title",
      "examples": [
        "Q4 Sales Report",
        "Customer Contract",
        "Meeting Notes"
      ],
      "description": "The title/name of the file in Salesforce. If not specified, the filename from the uploaded file will be used."
    },
    "filename": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Filename",
      "examples": [
        "document.pdf",
        "image.jpg",
        "report.txt"
      ],
      "description": "the name of the file (e.g., 'document.pdf'). Must be used together with 'content_b64'."
    },
    "content_b64": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Content B64",
      "description": "Base64-encoded file content. Must be used together with 'filename'."
    },
    "mimetype_override": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Mimetype Override",
      "examples": [
        "application/pdf",
        "image/jpeg",
        "text/plain"
      ],
      "description": "MIME type for the file when using filename/content_b64. Defaults to 'application/octet-stream' if not provided."
    },
    "first_publish_location_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "First Publish Location Id",
      "examples": [
        "001XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX",
        "003XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX",
        "00QXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the record to associate the file with (typically an 18-character Salesforce ID). If not specified, the file is uploaded to the user's personal library. Can be Account, Contact, Lead, Opportunity, or other record IDs."
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_UPLOAD_JOB_DATA
Tool to upload CSV data to a Salesforce Bulk API v2 ingest job. Use after creating a job and before closing it. Only ONE upload is allowed per job - multiple uploads will fail. After upload, close the job with state 'UploadComplete' to begin processing.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UploadJobDataRequest",
  "required": [
    "job_id",
    "csv_data"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "job_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Job Id",
      "examples": [
        "750dN00000BIVIOQA5",
        "750XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the Bulk API v2 ingest job to upload data to. This is the job ID returned from job creation."
    },
    "csv_data": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Csv Data",
      "examples": [
        "Name,Description\nTest Account 1,First test account\nTest Account 2,Second test account",
        "FirstName,LastName,Email\nJohn,Doe,john@example.com\nJane,Smith,jane@example.com"
      ],
      "description": "The CSV-formatted data to upload. First row must contain column headers matching Salesforce object field names. Subsequent rows contain the data records. Line endings must match the lineEnding parameter specified during job creation (LF or CRLF)."
    }
  }
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "UploadJobDataResponse": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "UploadJobDataResponse",
      "properties": {},
      "description": "Response from uploading data to a Bulk API v2 ingest job.\n\nHTTP 201 Created - Salesforce returns empty body on successful upload.\nAfter receiving this response, the job must be closed by setting state to\n'UploadComplete' to begin processing the data."
    }
  },
  "title": "UploadJobDataResponseWrapper",
  "required": [
    "data",
    "successful"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Data",
      "properties": {},
      "description": "Data from the action execution"
    },
    "error": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Error",
      "description": "Error if any occurred during the execution of the action"
    },
    "successful": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Successful",
      "description": "Whether or not the action execution was successful or not"
    }
  }
}
```

## SALESFORCE_UPSERT_SOBJECT_BY_EXTERNAL_ID
Tool to upsert records using sObject Rows by External ID. Use when you need to create or update a Salesforce record based on an external ID field value - creates a new record if the external ID doesn't exist, or updates the existing record if it does.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpsertSobjectByExternalIdRequest",
  "required": [
    "sobject",
    "field_name",
    "field_value",
    "fields"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "fields": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Fields",
      "examples": [
        {
          "Name": "Updated Account via PATCH",
          "Industry": "Finance"
        },
        {
          "Email": "john@example.com",
          "LastName": "Doe",
          "FirstName": "John"
        }
      ],
      "description": "JSON object containing the fields to create or update. Field names should be the Salesforce API names with their corresponding values.",
      "additionalProperties": true
    },
    "sobject": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sobject",
      "examples": [
        "Account",
        "Contact",
        "Lead",
        "CustomObject__c"
      ],
      "description": "The API name of the Salesforce object (e.g., Account, Contact, CustomObject__c)."
    },
    "field_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Field Name",
      "examples": [
        "Id",
        "ExternalId__c",
        "CustomExternalField__c"
      ],
      "description": "The API name of the external ID field. This field must be marked as 'External ID' in Salesforce."
    },
    "field_value": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Field Value",
      "examples": [
        "001dN00000lvZZ9QAM",
        "EXT-12345",
        "CUSTOM-ID-789"
      ],
      "description": "The value of the external ID for the specific record to upsert."
    },
    "update_only": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Update Only",
      "description": "Available in API v61.0+. When set to true, only updates existing records without creating new ones. Returns 404 if record doesn't exist."
    }
  }
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "UpsertSobjectByExternalIdResponse": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "UpsertSobjectByExternalIdResponse",
      "properties": {
        "id": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Id",
          "description": "The Salesforce record ID (18-character ID). Only present for insert operations (201 Created)."
        },
        "created": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Created",
          "description": "True if a new record was created. Only present for insert operations (201 Created)."
        }
      },
      "description": "Response from Salesforce upsert operation.\n\nHTTP 204 No Content - Salesforce returns empty body on successful update.\nHTTP 201 Created - Salesforce returns the created record ID (for insert).\nError responses (4xx/5xx) are handled via raise_for_status()."
    }
  },
  "title": "UpsertSobjectByExternalIdResponseWrapper",
  "required": [
    "data",
    "successful"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Data",
      "properties": {
        "id": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Id",
          "description": "The Salesforce record ID (18-character ID). Only present for insert operations (201 Created)."
        },
        "created": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Created",
          "description": "True if a new record was created. Only present for insert operations (201 Created)."
        }
      },
      "description": "Data from the action execution"
    },
    "error": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Error",
      "description": "Error if any occurred during the execution of the action"
    },
    "successful": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Successful",
      "description": "Whether or not the action execution was successful or not"
    }
  }
}
```
